right.english: Caring for parents is a duty children cannot fail to fulfill.

items.question: When do you use 不得不 instead of 不能不?
items.answer: 不得不 conveys reluctant resignation forced by external hardship (illness, fire, accidents).
items.wrongTraditional: 房子被燒了，他不能不搬到朋友家住。
items.wrongSimplified: 房子被烧了，他不能不搬到朋友家住。

right.traditional: 房子被燒了，他不得不搬到朋友家住。
right.simplified: 房子被烧了，他不得不搬到朋友家住。
right.pinyin: Fángzi bèi shāo le, tā bùdébù bān dào péngyou jiā zhù.
right.english: His house burned down; he had no choice but to move to a friend's house.

questions.prompt: Choose the term expressing reluctant lack of choice:

segments.hint: had no choice but to give up

questions.correctFeedback: 不得不放棄 accurately conveys the reluctant sacrifice forced by illness.
questions.repairFeedback: 不得不 expresses helplessness in having to perform an unwanted action.

practice.title: Practice: 不能不 / 不得不

items.prompt: A notes your very early arrival. Explain obligation due to far commute:

result.traditional: 上班地點很遠，我不能不早一點出門。
result.simplified: 上班地点很远，我不能不早一点出门。
result.pinyin: Shàngbān dìdiǎn hěn yuǎn, wǒ bùnéng bù zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén.
result.english: Work is very far; I have no choice but to head out a bit early.

repairs.note: 遲 means late, defeating the purpose of rising early.
絕不肯 means stubbornly refuses to, contradicting your arrival.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不能不早.

items.prompt: A asks why you study in library for days. Express scholarship diligence:

segments.traditional: 你為什麼一連幾天下了課還去圖書館？
因為我想拿獎學金，所以

result.traditional: 因為我想拿獎學金，所以不能不用功讀書。
result.simplified: 因为我想拿奖学金，所以不能不用功读书。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng ná jiǎngxuéjīn, suǒyǐ bùnéng bù yònggōng dúshū.
result.english: Because I want to win the scholarship, I cannot but study diligently.

repairs.note: 不必 means no need, which directly contradicts hard study.
不想 means not wanting to, contradicting personal ambition.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不能不用.

items.prompt: Typhoon wrecked Mr. Wang's house. Explain his forced move:

segments.traditional: 最近很少看到王先生，他怎麼了？

result.traditional: 颱風破壞了房子，他不得不搬到朋友家住一陣子。
result.simplified: 台风破坏了房子，他不得不搬到朋友家住一阵子。
result.pinyin: Táifēng pòhuài le fángzi, tā bùdébù bān dào péngyou jiā zhù yízhènzi.
result.english: The typhoon wrecked his house; he had no choice but to move to a friend's house for a while.

repairs.note: 絕不會 contradicts his actual relocation.
不必 removes the compelling urgency caused by house damage.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不得不搬.

items.prompt: Officer stopped you for speeding to an exam. Apologize with helpless circumstance:

segments.traditional: 先生，你剛才騎車騎得太快了，請出示證件。

result.traditional: 今天有重要期末考，我不得不騎快一點，對不起警官。
result.simplified: 今天有重要期末考，我不得不骑快一点，对不起警官。
result.pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu zhòngyào qīmòkǎo, wǒ bùdébù qí kuài yìdiǎn, duìbuqǐ jǐngguān.
result.english: There is an important final exam today; I had no choice but to ride faster, sorry officer.

repairs.note: 絕不能 implies strict prohibition, which contradicts your confession.
不必 removes the desperate pressure caused by being late for the exam.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不得不騎.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Just Coinciding with / Just About To
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe coincident timing right as an intended action begins using 正＋V.
grammarPages.explanation: 「正」當副詞，有剛好、巧合的意思。表示第一件事剛好準備要做或剛開始做時，第二件事巧合地發生了。「正」後面常接「要、想、打算、準備」等動詞，表示「正要……的時候，巧合的事情發生了」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 正 + Verb (要/想/打算/準備) + Action 1，Coincident Action 2

text.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞。
text.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bōzhe xīnwén.
text.english: One day as Zhang Wenhua was just preparing to leave for work, he saw the news playing on TV.

text.traditional: 我正想打電話給小紀時，就接到他打來的電話。
text.simplified: 我正想打电话给小纪时，就接到他打来的电话。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng xiǎng dǎ diànhuà gěi Xiǎo Jì shí, jiù jiēdào tā dǎ lái de diànhuà.
text.english: Just as I was thinking of calling Xiao Ji, I received a phone call from him.

text.traditional: 我正要進電梯時，突然發生地震，還好我沒進去。
text.simplified: 我正要进电梯时，突然发生地震，还好我没进去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yào jìn diàntī shí, tūrán fāshēng dìzhèn, hái hǎo wǒ méi jìnqù.
text.english: Just as I was about to enter the elevator, an earthquake struck; luckily I hadn't stepped inside.

words.meaning: I was about to enter elevator

items.question: What is the difference between 正＋V and 正在＋V?
items.answer: 正＋V marks the exact threshold moment or coincidence right as an intention starts (often with 要/想/打算/準備). 正在＋V marks continuous ongoing duration.
items.wrongTraditional: 我正在要出門，你就來了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我正在要出门，你就来了。

right.traditional: 我正要出門，你就來了。
right.simplified: 我正要出门，你就来了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yào chūmén, nǐ jiù lái le.
right.english: Just as I was about to head out, you arrived.

words.meaning: I was about to head out

items.question: What verbs typically follow 正 to express threshold timing?
items.answer: Verbs expressing impending action or intention such as 要, 想, 打算, and 準備.
items.wrongTraditional: 有一天他正已經出門，看到新聞。
items.wrongSimplified: 有一天他正已经出门，看到新闻。

right.traditional: 有一天他正準備出門，看到新聞。
right.simplified: 有一天他正准备出门，看到新闻。
right.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān tā zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén, kàndào xīnwén.
right.english: One day right as he was preparing to leave, he saw the news.

questions.prompt: Select the sentence describing a coincidence just as you were about to call:

segments.hint: was just thinking of finding you

questions.correctFeedback: 正想找你 denotes the exact coincident moment.
questions.repairFeedback: 正＋想 expresses coincident timing right as you were about to call.

items.prompt: A brings umbrella in heavy rain. Note the coincidence just as you were leaving for convenience store:

segments.traditional: 突然下大雨，我想起你沒帶傘就幫你送來了。
超商買傘時，你就送來了，太謝謝了！

result.traditional: 我正打算去超商買傘時，你就送來了，太謝謝了！
result.simplified: 我正打算去超商买伞时，你就送来了，太谢谢了！
result.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng dǎsuàn qù chāoshāng mǎi sǎn shí, nǐ jiù sònglái le, tài xièxie le!
result.english: Right as I was planning to go buy an umbrella at the store, you brought one over; thank you so much!

repairs.note: 剛去 means already went, which contradicts still needing an umbrella.
總算 expresses long-delayed arrival rather than immediate intention.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 正打算去.

items.prompt: Mom found book under sofa just as sister was checking there:

segments.traditional: 聽說妳找書找了半天，結果媽媽幫妳在沙發下找到了。
沙發下面的時候，媽媽就找到了。

result.traditional: 是啊，我正要看看沙發下面的時候，媽媽就找到了。
result.simplified: 是啊，我正要看看沙发下面的时候，妈妈就找到了。
result.pinyin: Shì a, wǒ zhèng yào kànkan shāfā xiàmiàn de shíhou, māma jiù zhǎodào le.
result.english: Yes, just as I was about to check under the sofa, mom found it.

repairs.note: 正巧不看 means coincidentally not looking, which is nonsensical.
正在 expresses prolonged ongoing contemplation instead of the immediate point of action.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 正要看看.

items.prompt: Earthquake stopped right as you were about to rush out the door:

segments.traditional: 剛才發生地震的時候，怎麼沒看到你跑出來？

result.traditional: 當我正要開門跑出去時，地震就停了。
result.simplified: 当我正要开门跑出去时，地震就停了。
result.pinyin: Dāng wǒ zhèng yào kāimén pǎo chūqù shí, dìzhèn jiù tíng le.
result.english: Just as I was about to open the door and rush out, the earthquake stopped.

repairs.note: 已經 means already done, missing the critical threshold moment.
總是 means always/habitually, which doesn't fit a sudden earthquake.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 正要開門.

items.prompt: Surfing friend visits right when you wanted someone to practice with:

segments.traditional: 陪我去練衝浪，你就來了。
太棒了，走吧！今天浪況非常好！

result.traditional: 真巧！我正想找你陪我去練衝浪，你就來了。
result.simplified: 真巧！我正想找你陪我去练冲浪，你就来了。
result.pinyin: Zhēn qiǎo! Wǒ zhèng xiǎng zhǎo nǐ péi wǒ qù liàn chōnglàng, nǐ jiù lái le.
result.english: What a coincidence! Right as I was thinking of asking you to practice surfing with me, you showed up.

repairs.note: 沒想找你 means wasn't thinking of finding you, contradicting 真巧.
總是 means always, losing the exact coincident timing.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 正想找你.

dialogue.title: 走吧！當背包客去

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 東賢，你姊姊是不是又計畫去旅行了？
lines.simplified: 东贤，你姊姊是不是又计划去旅行了？
lines.pinyin: Dōngxián, nǐ jiějie shì bú shì yòu jìhuà qù lǚxíng le?
lines.english: Dongxian, is your older sister planning another trip again?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 沒錯。她正準備去非洲大草原。
lines.simplified: 没错。她正准备去非洲大草原。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò. Tā zhèng zhǔnbèi qù Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán.
lines.english: That's right. She's just getting ready to go to the African savanna.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我常看她部落格裡的背包客日記，不但內容充實、想法獨特，而且跟旅遊相關的建議也寫得很詳細，讓我打開了視野。
lines.simplified: 我常看她部落格里的背包客日记，不但内容充实、想法独特，而且跟旅游相关的建议也写得很详细，让我打开了视野。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cháng kàn tā bùluògé lǐ de bēibāokè rìjì, búdàn nèiróng chōngshí, xiǎngfǎ dútè, érqiě gēn lǚyóu xiāngguān de jiànyì yě xiě de hěn xiángxì, ràng wǒ dǎkāi le shìyě.
lines.english: I often read the backpacker diary on her blog. Not only is the content substantial and original, but the travel tips are written in great detail, which broadened my horizons.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我姊姊真的很厲害，一個人上山下海到處旅行。數一數，她已經去過三十幾個國家了。因為她的關係，我也對旅行產生了興趣，上個月她來臺灣時，我們還一起騎自行車環島呢！
lines.simplified: 我姊姊真的很厉害，一个人上山下海到处旅行。数一数，她已经去过三十几个国家了。因为她的关系，我也对旅行产生了兴趣，上个月她来台湾时，我们还一起骑自行车环岛呢！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zhēnde hěn lìhai, yì ge rén shàngshān xiàhǎi dàochù lǚxíng. Shǔ yì shǔ, tā yǐjīng qù guò sānshí jǐ ge guójiā le. Yīnwèi tā de guānxì, wǒ yě duì lǚxíng chǎnshēng le xìngqù, shàng ge yuè tā lái Táiwān shí, wǒmen hái yìqǐ qí zìxíngchē huándǎo ne!
lines.english: My sister is truly amazing, traveling everywhere by herself from mountains to seas. Counting them up, she's visited over thirty countries. Because of her, I also got interested in travel; when she came to Taiwan last month, we even cycled around the island together!

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 真好。我猜，這次的環島旅行一定讓你姊姊很難忘吧？
lines.simplified: 真好。我猜，这次的环岛旅行一定让你姊姊很难忘吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo. Wǒ cāi, zhè cì de huándǎo lǚxíng yídìng ràng nǐ jiějie hěn nánwàng ba?
lines.english: How wonderful. I bet this island-cycling trip was unforgettable for your sister?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 唉，怎麼說呢？我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
lines.simplified: 唉，怎么说呢？我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
lines.pinyin: Ài, zěnme shuō ne? Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxī cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.
lines.english: Well, how should I put it? We originally planned a 10-day trip, but unfortunately it ended after just 6 days.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 怎麼回事？
lines.simplified: 怎么回事？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme huí shì?
lines.english: What happened?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我們的運氣很差，碰到了壞天氣。出發前，氣象預報說那幾天都是晴天。頭幾天的天氣很好，誰知道到了第六天，一到山區天空就突然變黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都濕了，自行車也壞了。
lines.simplified: 我们的运气很差，碰到了坏天气。出发前，气象预报说那几天都是晴天。头几天的天气很好，谁知道到了第六天，一到山区天空就突然变黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都湿了，自行车也坏了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen de yùnqì hěn chà, pèngdào le huài tiānqì. Chūfā qián, qìxiàng yùbào shuō nà jǐ tiān dōu shì qíngtiān. Tóu jǐ tiān de tiānqì hěn hǎo, shéi zhīdào dào le dì-liù tiān, yí dào shānqū tiānkōng jiù tūrán biàn hēi, yě xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒ de yīfu dōu shī le, zìxíngchē yě huài le.
lines.english: Our luck was terrible; we ran into bad weather. Before leaving, the weather forecast said those days would all be sunny. The first few days were great, but on the sixth day, as soon as we hit the mountains the sky turned black and heavy rain poured down. My clothes were soaked and my bike broke down.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 那真糟糕！不過山區的天氣本來變化就很大，有時山下還是晴天，山上已經變涼，甚至起風、下雨了。後來你們怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那真糟糕！不过山区的天气本来变化就很大，有时山下还是晴天，山上已经变凉，甚至起风、下雨了。后来你们怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zhēn zāogāo! Búguò shānqū de tiānqì běnlái biànhuà jiù hěn dà, yǒushí shānxià háishì qíngtiān, shānshàng yǐjīng biàn liáng, shènzhì qǐfēng, xiàyǔ le. Hòulái nǐmen zěnme bàn?
lines.english: That's awful! But mountain weather changes a lot naturally; sometimes it's still sunny at the foot of the mountain while cool, windy, or rainy up top. What did you do then?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 那時，我們的手機訊號很弱，一直連絡不到能修理的人，只好推著自行車走了很長的一段路。
lines.simplified: 那时，我们的手机讯号很弱，一直连络不到能修理的人，只好推着自行车走了很长的一段路。
lines.pinyin: Nà shí, wǒmen de shǒujī xùnhào hěn ruò, yìzhí liánluò bú dào néng xiūlǐ de rén, zhǐhǎo tuī zhe zìxíngchē zǒu le hěn cháng de yí duàn lù.
lines.english: Back then our cell reception was very weak and we couldn't reach anyone to repair it, so we had no choice but to push the bikes along a long stretch of road.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 附近沒有商店嗎？有沒有車子經過？
lines.simplified: 附近没有商店吗？有没有车子经过？
lines.pinyin: Fùjìn méiyǒu shāngdiàn ma? Yǒu méiyǒu chēzi jīngguò?
lines.english: Were there no shops nearby? Did any cars pass by?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 那是在偏僻的山區，附近什麼都沒有。還好後來遇到一個當地人，他幫我們把車修好。沒想到那時候我姊姊突然發燒了，我們不得不縮短行程，趕快下山去醫院。
lines.simplified: 那是在偏僻的山区，附近什么都没有。还好后来遇到一个当地人，他帮我们把车修好。没想到那时候我姊姊突然发烧了，我们不得不缩短行程，赶快下山去医院。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì zài piānpì de shānqū, fùjìn shénme dōu méiyǒu. Hái hǎo hòulái yùdào yí ge dāngdì rén, tā bāng wǒmen bǎ chē xiū hǎo. Méi xiǎngdào nà shíhou wǒ jiějie tūrán fāshāo le, wǒmen bùdébù suōduǎn xíngchéng, gǎnkuài xiàshān qù yīyuàn.
lines.english: It was in a remote mountain area with nothing around. Fortunately we ran into a local who fixed our bike. Little did we expect my sister suddenly ran a fever, so we had to cut the trip short and hurry down the mountain to the hospital.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 聽起來這次的旅行不太順利。不過話說回來，就是因為不確定會碰到什麼，所以旅行才這麼迷人。
lines.simplified: 听起来这次的旅行不太顺利。不过话说回来，就是因为不确定会碰到什么，所以旅行才这么迷人。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlai zhè cì de lǚxíng bú tài shùnlì. Búguò huàshuō huílái, jiùshì yīnwèi bú quèdìng huì pèngdào shénme, suǒyǐ lǚxíng cái zhème mírén.
lines.english: Sounds like this trip wasn't very smooth. But then again, it's precisely because you never know what you'll encounter that travel is so enchanting.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 沒錯，我姊姊也是這麼說的。
lines.simplified: 没错，我姊姊也是这么说的。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò, wǒ jiějie yě shì zhème shuō de.
lines.english: Exactly; my sister said so too.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 你姊姊這次去非洲，還是一個人去嗎？有個人陪比較好吧。
lines.simplified: 你姊姊这次去非洲，还是一样一个人去吗？有个人陪比较好吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiějie zhè cì qù Fēizhōu, háishì yí ge rén qù ma? Yǒu ge rén péi bǐjiào hǎo ba.
lines.english: Is your sister going to Africa by herself again this time? It might be better to have someone accompany her.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 她早就習慣一個人旅行了，想去哪裡就去哪裡，不必在意別人的想法。再說，她的旅行經驗這麼豐富，一個人去絕對沒問題的。像規劃行程、辦簽證，上網查當地的氣溫、地形等等，對她來說，都是小事。
lines.simplified: 她早就习惯一个人旅行了，想去哪里就去哪里，不必在意别人的想法。再说，她的旅行经验这么丰富，一个人去绝对没问题的。像规划行程、办签证，上网查当地的气温、地形等等，对她来说，都是小事。
lines.pinyin: Tā zǎojiù xíguàn yí ge rén lǚxíng le, xiǎng qù nǎlǐ jiù qù nǎlǐ, bú bì zàiyì biérén de xiǎngfǎ. Zàishuō, tā de lǚxíng jīngyàn zhème fēngfù, yí ge rén qù juéduì méi wèntí de. Xiàng guīhuà xíngchéng, bàn qiānzhèng, shàngwǎng chá dāngdì de qìwēn, dìxíng děngděng, duì tā lái shuō, dōu shì xiǎoshì.
lines.english: She's long used to solo travel: going wherever she wants without having to care about others' opinions. Besides, with her rich travel experience, going alone is no problem at all. Planning itineraries, applying for visas, checking weather and terrain online—to her, these are all easy.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
lines.simplified: 这么说，不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bu chéng de?
lines.english: So that means, wherever she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她認為只有走出舒服的生活環境，才能發現不一樣的自己。
lines.simplified: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她认为只有走出舒服的生活环境，才能发现不一样的自己。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ jiějie yǒu bēibāokè de xìnggé, tā rènwéi zhǐyǒu zǒuchū shūfu de shēnghuó huánjìng, cái néng fāxiàn bù yíyàng de zìjǐ.
lines.english: Yeah. My sister has the spirit of a backpacker; she believes only by stepping out of one's comfort zone can one discover a different self.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 難怪你姊姊的背包客日記，內容總是那麼吸引人。
lines.simplified: 难怪你姊姊的背包客日记，内容总是那么吸引人。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ jiějie de bēibāokè rìjì, nèiróng zǒngshì nàme xīyǐnrén.
lines.english: No wonder her backpacker diary is always so captivating.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 對了，你不是剛跟女朋友分開了嗎？要是你因為失戀而覺得很痛苦，就當個背包客出去走走吧。
lines.simplified: 对了，你不是刚跟女朋友分开了吗？要是你因为失恋而觉得很痛苦，就当个背包客出去走走吧。
lines.pinyin: Duì le, nǐ bú shì gāng gēn nǚpéngyou fēnkāi le ma? Yàoshi nǐ yīnwèi shīliàn ér juéde hěn tòngkǔ, jiù dāng ge bēibāokè chūqù zǒuzou ba.
lines.english: By the way, didn't you just break up with your girlfriend? If you're hurting from the heartbreak, why not go on a backpacking trip to clear your head?

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express unexpected brevity, small quantity, or rapid immediate consequence using 才……就…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「才……就……」有兩種主要用法：(1)「才」強調時間短、數量少、次數少或程度低，後面接「就」表示緊接著出現的事實，說話者對這樣的情況感到驚訝或認為不足；(2)「才」後面的動作剛發生，「就」後面的動作緊接著發生，表示兩件事銜接得非常緊密。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 才 + Brief Action / Small Quantity + 就 + Consequence

text.traditional: 我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
text.simplified: 我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxī cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.
text.english: We originally planned a ten-day trip, but unfortunately it ended in only six days.

text.traditional: 他能力很強，才二十幾歲就已經是三家公司的老闆了。
text.simplified: 他能力很强，才二十几岁就已经是三家公司的老板了。
text.pinyin: Tā nénglì hěn qiáng, cái èrshí jǐ suì jiù yǐjīng shì sān jiā gōngsī de lǎobǎn le.
text.english: He is very capable; at barely twenty-something he is already the boss of three companies.

text.traditional: 弟弟才剛畢業就立刻找到了一份好工作，運氣真好。
text.simplified: 弟弟才刚毕业就立刻找到了一份好工作，运气真好。
text.pinyin: Dìdi cái gāng bìyè jiù lìkè zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò, yùnqì zhēn hǎo.
text.english: My younger brother barely graduated when he immediately found a good job; what great luck.

items.question: How does 才……就 differ from 剛……就?
items.answer: 才……就 emphasizes surprising brevity, small quantity, or earliness. 剛……就 merely denotes that an event just took place temporally.
items.wrongTraditional: 他剛學了三天就說得非常好。
items.wrongSimplified: 他刚学了三天就说得非常好。

right.traditional: 他才學了三天就說得非常好。
right.simplified: 他才学了三天就说得非常好。
right.pinyin: Tā cái xué le sān tiān jiù shuō de fēicháng hǎo.
right.english: He studied for only three days and already speaks very well.

items.question: Can 就 be omitted in the 才……就 structure?
items.answer: No, 就 connects the surprising premise (marked by 才) to the resulting rapid event or state.
items.wrongTraditional: 我才出門而且下雨了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我才出门而且下雨了。

right.traditional: 我才出門就下起雨來了。
right.simplified: 我才出门就下起雨来了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ cái chūmén jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
right.english: No sooner had I stepped out the door than it started raining.

questions.prompt: Express surprise at how fast a phone ran out of battery:

segments.hint: barely used an hour and already

tiles.pinyin: cái yòng le yì xiǎoshí jiù

questions.correctFeedback: 才……就 highlights the unexpectedly short duration before running out of power.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 才……就 to emphasize unexpected brevity.

items.prompt: A is amazed by Xiao Lu's tones. Complete B's praise of his quick progress:

segments.traditional: 小陸的中文聲調怎麼說得那麼好啊！
課，就把每個聲調都說對了。

result.traditional: 他挺厲害的，才上幾天課，就把每個聲調都說對了。
result.simplified: 他挺厉害的，才上几天课，就把每个声调都说对了。
result.pinyin: Tā tǐng lìhai de, cái shàng jǐ tiān kè, jiù bǎ měi ge shēngdiào dōu shuō duì le.
result.english: He's amazing; after only taking a few days of classes, he got every tone right.

repairs.note: 總算 expresses long-delayed relief, not surprisingly rapid mastery.
剛剛 lacks the emphasis on short duration that pairs with 就.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 才上幾天.

items.prompt: A wonders where boss went before singing. Explain his fleeting stay:

segments.traditional: 老闆去哪裡了？等一下不是要去唱歌嗎？

result.traditional: 他才進來一下，就說有事先走了。
result.simplified: 他才进来一下，就说有事先走了。
result.pinyin: Tā cái jìnlái yíxià, jiù shuō yǒu shì xiān zǒu le.
result.english: He only stepped in for a second, then said he had something to do and left.

repairs.note: 總算 implies a long wait before entering.
打算 states a plan, but he already entered and left.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 才進來一.

items.prompt: You feel confused and forgetful lately. Describe forgetting immediately:

segments.traditional: 你最近是不是睡不好？看起來精神不太好。

result.traditional: 我上一秒才想做一件事，下一秒就忘記了。
result.simplified: 我上一秒才想做一件事，下一秒就忘记了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ shàng yì miǎo cái xiǎng zuò yí jiàn shì, xià yì miǎo jiù wàngjì le.
result.english: One second I just thought of doing something, and the very next second I forgot.

repairs.note: 打算 lacks the tight immediate temporal contrast with 就.
總是 indicates constant habit rather than rapid lapse.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 才想做一.

items.prompt: Tell store clerk the recommended phone died after barely 1 hour of use:

segments.traditional: 先生，這款手機用得還滿意嗎？
時就沒電了，電池好像有問題。

result.traditional: 我才用一小時就沒電了，電池好像有問題。
result.simplified: 我才用一小时就没电了，电池好像有问题。
result.pinyin: Wǒ cái yòng yì xiǎoshí jiù méidiàn le, diànchí hǎoxiàng yǒu wèntí.
result.english: I only used it for one hour and it already ran out of power; seems there's a battery issue.

repairs.note: 總算 conveys long-desired relief, which does not fit battery drain.
常用 expresses frequent habit rather than immediate depletion.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 才用一小.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: On the Other Hand / Then Again
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Balance an agreed point with a realistic counter-consideration using 話說回來.
grammarPages.explanation: 「話說回來」用於對話中，說話的人在認同或不反對對方的說法之後，進一步提出自己不同、補充或更切合實際的看法；也可以用來拉回談話的主題。前面常搭配「不過、可是、但是」等轉折詞。
grammarPages.pattern: Agreed Point，(不過/可是/但是) + 話說回來，Counter-Perspective

text.traditional: 不過話說回來，就是因為不確定會碰到什麼，所以旅行才這麼迷人。
text.simplified: 不过话说回来，就是因为不确定会碰到什么，所以旅行才这么迷人。
text.pinyin: Búguò huàshuō huílái, jiùshì yīnwèi bú quèdìng huì pèngdào shénme, suǒyǐ lǚxíng cái zhème mírén.
text.english: Then again, it's precisely because you never know what you'll encounter that travel is so enchanting.

text.traditional: 上網找資料方便。不過話說回來，網路上的資料不一定都是對的。
text.simplified: 上网找资料方便。不过话说回来，网络上的资料不一定都是对的。
text.pinyin: Shàngwǎng zhǎo zīliào fāngbiàn. Búguò huàshuō huílái, wǎnglù shàng de zīliào bù yídìng dōu shì duì de.
text.english: Searching online is convenient. But then again, info on the web isn't necessarily all accurate.

text.traditional: 捷運站旁很吵。可是話說回來，你當初不是說方便最重要嗎？
text.simplified: 捷运站旁很吵。可是话说回来，你当初不是说方便最重要吗？
text.pinyin: Jiéyùnzhàn páng hěn chǎo. Kěshì huàshuō huílái, nǐ dāngchū bú shì shuō fāngbiàn zuì zhòngyào ma?
text.english: It's noisy near the subway station. But then again, didn't you initially say convenience was most important?

items.question: What function does 話說回來 perform in conversation?
items.answer: It introduces a balanced, realistic counter-point without directly attacking or invalidating the other person's earlier observation.
items.wrongTraditional: 不過總而言之，網路資料不全對。
items.wrongSimplified: 不过总而言之，网络资料不全对。

right.traditional: 不過話說回來，網路資料不全對。
right.simplified: 不过话说回来，网络资料不全对。
right.pinyin: Búguò huàshuō huílái, wǎnglù zīliào bù quán duì.
right.english: Then again, web information is not entirely accurate.

items.question: What conjunctions usually precede 話說回來?
items.answer: Adversative words such as 不過, 可是, or 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 因為話說回來，旅行也是很危險的。
items.wrongSimplified: 因为话说回来，旅行也是很危险的。

right.traditional: 可是話說回來，旅行也是很危險的。
right.simplified: 可是话说回来，旅行也是很危险的。
right.pinyin: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, lǚxíng yě shì hěn wēixiǎn de.
right.english: Then again, traveling can also be very dangerous.

questions.prompt: Introduce a balanced counter-perspective acknowledging the initial point:

segments.hint: then again / on the other hand

questions.correctFeedback: 不過話說回來 smoothly pivots to the other side of the coin.
questions.repairFeedback: 話說回來 pairs with adversatives like 不過 to introduce a counter-perspective.

items.prompt: Boss Xu tries extreme sports. Agree, but balance with safety for older age:

segments.traditional: 許老闆真行，滑雪、衝浪等戶外活動都願意嘗試。
回來，年紀大了還是要注意安全。

result.traditional: 是啊，不過話說回來，年紀大了還是要注意安全。
result.simplified: 是啊，不过话说回来，年纪大了还是要注意安全。
result.pinyin: Shì a, búguò huàshuō huílái, niánjì dà le háishì yào zhùyì ānquán.
result.english: True, but then again, when one gets older, safety still comes first.

repairs.note: 而且 adds parallel support, but this sentence introduces a counter-consideration.
因為 expresses cause, not a reflective balance of perspective.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不過話說.

items.prompt: Tour groups are easy. Agree on ease, but note loss of freedom:

segments.traditional: 參加團體旅遊很輕鬆，不必自己訂票訂旅館，真好！

result.traditional: 輕鬆是輕鬆，但是話說回來，自由度就少多了。
result.simplified: 轻松是轻松，但是话说回来，自由度就少多了。
result.pinyin: Qīngsōng shì qīngsōng, dànshì huàshuō huílái, zìyóudù jiù shǎo duō le.
result.english: It is indeed relaxing, but then again, you have far less freedom.

repairs.note: 所以 establishes logical consequence, not a counter-balanced reflection.
如果 sets an unconfirmed conditional hypothesis.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 但是話說.

items.prompt: A is shocked 60% stay home on weekends. Add that work exhaustion explains it:

segments.traditional: 調查說六成人放假在家上網睡覺，太讓人驚訝了！
回來，平時工作太累想多休息也很正常。

result.traditional: 可是話說回來，平時工作太累想多休息也很正常。
result.simplified: 可是话说回来，平时工作太累想多休息也很正常。
result.pinyin: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, píngshí gōngzuò tài lèi xiǎng duō xiūxi yě hěn zhèngcháng.
result.english: Then again, when work is exhausting during the week, wanting more rest is normal too.

repairs.note: 既然 introduces an accepted premise, not an adversative shift.
只要 sets a sufficient condition.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 可是話說.

items.prompt: Classmate says exes can't stay friends. Acknowledge point, but note it's not impossible:

segments.traditional: 兩個人分開之後，就很難再當朋友了吧。
回來，如果大家成熟一點還是可能的。

result.traditional: 你說得有道理，不過話說回來，如果大家成熟一點還是可能的。
result.simplified: 你说得有道理，不过话说回来，如果大家成熟一点还是可能的。
result.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yǒu dàolǐ, búguò huàshuō huílái, rúguǒ dàjiā chéngshú yìdiǎn háishì kěnéng de.
result.english: You make a good point, but then again, if everyone is mature it's still possible.

repairs.note: 為了 expresses purpose, which is ungrammatical with 話說回來.
除了 introduces exclusions, not a balanced turn in discussion.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不過話說.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Deduce a logical conclusion from a conversation partner's statement using 這麼說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「這麼說」意思是「按照你說的情況來看」。說話者根據對方剛才敘述的事實或情況，提出自己的合理推論、判斷或結論。
grammarPages.pattern: Partner Statement → 這麼說，+ Deduction / Inference

text.traditional: 這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
text.simplified: 这么说，不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
text.pinyin: Zhème shuō, bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bu chéng de?
text.english: In that case, wherever she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

text.traditional: 小張孩子快滿月了。這麼說，他會請同事吃油飯和紅蛋了。
text.simplified: 小张孩子快满月了。这么说，他会请同事吃油饭和红蛋了。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng háizi kuài mǎnyuè le. Zhème shuō, tā huì qǐng tóngshì chī yóufàn hé hóngdàn le.
text.english: Xiao Zhang's baby is almost a month old. In that case, he'll treat coworkers to oily rice and red eggs.

text.traditional: 強颱明天經過北部。這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
text.simplified: 强台明天经过北部。这么说，明天可能会放台风假喔！
text.pinyin: Qiángtái míngtiān jīngguò běibù. Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià o!
text.english: A strong typhoon passes the north tomorrow. That means tomorrow might be a typhoon holiday!

items.question: How does 這麼說 differ from 也就是說?
items.answer: 這麼說 draws a tentative deduction from someone else's statement. 也就是說 restates or clarifies the same meaning in other words.
items.wrongTraditional: 也就是說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
items.wrongSimplified: 也就是说，明天可能会放台风假喔！

right.traditional: 這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
right.simplified: 这么说，明天可能会放台风假喔！
right.pinyin: Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià o!
right.english: In that case, tomorrow might be a typhoon day off!

items.question: What position does 這麼說 take in a sentence?
items.answer: It stands at the beginning of the responsive turn, preceding the speaker's deduction.
items.wrongTraditional: 明天可能會放颱風假，這麼說！
items.wrongSimplified: 明天可能会放台风假，这么说！

right.traditional: 這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假！
right.simplified: 这么说，明天可能会放台风假！
right.pinyin: Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià!
right.english: In that case, tomorrow might be a typhoon day off!

questions.prompt: Draw a conclusion after someone drank espresso late:
questions.correctFeedback: 這麼說 naturally introduces the logical conclusion based on their coffee intake.
questions.repairFeedback: 這麼說 begins a deductive inference from the speaker's premise.

items.prompt: A drank coffee late and stayed awake. Deduce insomnia tonight:

segments.traditional: 我昨天下午喝了一大杯咖啡，到半夜精神還很好。
今天晚上肯定睡不著了。

result.traditional: 這麼說你今天晚上肯定睡不著了。
result.simplified: 这么说你今天晚上肯定睡不着了。
result.pinyin: Zhème shuō nǐ jīntiān wǎnshang kěndìng shuì bu zháo le.
result.english: In that case, you definitely won't be able to fall asleep tonight.

repairs.note: 總算 conveys relief after waiting, not a deduction.
總是 indicates constant frequency.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這麼說你.

items.prompt: A visited over 20 countries. Conclude rich travel experience:

segments.traditional: 我和我先生喜歡到處旅行，到現在去過二十幾個國家了。
們的旅遊經驗非常豐富了！

result.traditional: 這麼說你們的旅遊經驗非常豐富了！
result.simplified: 这么说你们的旅游经验非常丰富了！
result.pinyin: Zhème shuō nǐmen de lǚyóu jīngyàn fēicháng fēngfù le!
result.english: In that case, your travel experience is extremely rich!

repairs.note: 打算 indicates future intent, not a present deduction.
隨便 means casual/careless, which is inappropriate here.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這麼說你.

items.prompt: A thinks the station school has great teachers and location. Infer enrollment:

segments.traditional: 車站旁那家華語中心交通方便，老師也教得很好。

result.traditional: 這麼說你打算報名那家學校了？
result.simplified: 这么说你打算报名那家学校了？
result.pinyin: Zhème shuō nǐ dǎsuàn bàomíng nà jiā xuéxiào le?
result.english: In that case, do you plan to sign up for that school?

repairs.note: 難怪 explains a known reason, but here B is drawing an inference.
雖然 introduces concession rather than deduction.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這麼說你.

items.prompt: Friend feels down after breakup. Infer need to travel:

segments.traditional: 剛跟女朋友分手，我整天待在家裡心裡好難過。
現在最需要出去旅行散散心。

result.traditional: 這麼說你現在最需要出去旅行散散心。
result.simplified: 这么说你现在最需要出去旅行散散心。
result.pinyin: Zhème shuō nǐ xiànzài zuì xūyào chūqù lǚxíng sànsanxīn.
result.english: In that case, what you need most right now is to go travel and clear your head.

repairs.note: 如果 sets an unconfirmed hypothesis rather than an inference from his statement.
總算 indicates long-awaited relief, which does not fit heartbreak.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這麼說你.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express successful completion, failure, or possibility using V成, 沒V成, V得成, or V不成.
grammarPages.explanation: 「成」是結果補語，有成功、實現、完成的意思。「V成」表示動作已經實現；「沒V成」表示過去未能實現；「V得成」和「V不成」則表示未來或當下是否具備實現的可能性。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 成 / 不成 / 得成 / 沒 + Verb + 成

text.traditional: 不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
text.simplified: 不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
text.pinyin: Bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bu chéng de?
text.english: Wherever she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

text.traditional: 明天下雨機會很高，明天的跨年活動恐怕辦不成了。
text.simplified: 明天下雨机会很高，明天的跨年活动恐怕办不成了。
text.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàyǔ jīhuì hěn gāo, míngtiān de kuànián huódòng kǒngpà bàn bu chéng le.
text.english: The chance of rain tomorrow is high; tomorrow's New Year event probably can't be held.

text.traditional: 我們跟大公司的生意今天談成了，老闆要請大家吃大餐。
text.simplified: 我们跟大公司的生意今天谈成了，老板要请大家吃大餐。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen gēn dà gōngsī de shēngyì jīntiān tánchéng le, lǎobǎn yào qǐng dàjiā chī dàcān.
text.english: Our deal with the big corporation was finalized today; boss is treating us to a feast.

items.question: How does 沒V成 differ from V不成?
items.answer: 沒V成 refers to an action in the past that failed to materialize. V不成 indicates an ongoing or future impossibility.
items.wrongTraditional: 昨天的戶外音樂會，我們辦不成了。
items.wrongSimplified: 昨天的户外音乐会，我们办不成了。

right.traditional: 昨天的戶外音樂會，我們沒辦成。
right.simplified: 昨天的户外音乐会，我们没办成。
right.pinyin: Zuótiān de hùwài yīnyuèhuì, wǒmen méi bànchéng.
right.english: Yesterday's outdoor concert we didn't manage to hold.

items.question: What does V得成 express?
items.answer: V得成 expresses affirmative potential—that an action has the feasible capability to succeed.
items.wrongTraditional: 提早兩小時排隊，絕對買不成烤鴨。
items.wrongSimplified: 提早两小时排队，绝对买不成烤鸭。

right.traditional: 提早兩小時排隊，絕對買得成烤鴨。
right.simplified: 提早两小时排队，绝对买得成烤鸭。
right.pinyin: Tízǎo liǎng xiǎoshí páiduì, juéduì mǎi de chéng kǎoyā.
right.english: Line up two hours early and you will definitely succeed in buying roast duck.

questions.prompt: Express that a business deal was successfully finalized:
questions.correctFeedback: 談成了 indicates the negotiations were successfully concluded.
questions.repairFeedback: V成 signals successful realization of the action.

items.prompt: Boss Zhou canceled Europe business trip because visa wasn't processed:

segments.traditional: 周老闆這週怎麼還在辦公室？不是要去歐洲出差嗎？

result.traditional: 因為簽證沒辦成，所以出差取消了。
result.simplified: 因为签证没办成，所以出差取消了。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiānzhèng méi bànchéng, suǒyǐ chūchāi qǔxiāo le.
result.english: Because the visa wasn't successfully issued, the business trip was canceled.

repairs.note: 辦得成 indicates affirmative capability, contradicting the cancellation.
辦成過 indicates past successful completion.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 沒辦成.

items.prompt: Factory emergency arose. Express that today's meeting won't happen:

segments.traditional: 李經理，下午跟客戶的會議你還去參加嗎？
工廠出了急事，今天的會恐怕

result.traditional: 工廠出了急事，今天的會恐怕開不成了。
result.simplified: 工厂出了急事，今天的会恐怕开不成了。
result.pinyin: Gōngchǎng chū le jíshì, jīntiān de huì kǒngpà kāi bu chéng le.
result.english: An emergency came up at the factory; I'm afraid today's meeting won't be able to take place.

repairs.note: 開得成 indicates it can proceed, contradicting the emergency.
沒開成過 means never held before, which doesn't fit today's schedule.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 開不成了.

items.prompt: Popular roast duck sells out fast. Promise that early queue ensures success:

segments.traditional: 那家烤鴨店生意太好，我每次去都賣光了。
明天早兩小時排隊，這樣絕對

result.traditional: 明天早兩小時排隊，這樣絕對買得成。
result.simplified: 明天早两小时排队，这样绝对买得成。
result.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎo liǎng xiǎoshí páiduì, zhèyàng juéduì mǎi de chéng.
result.english: Queue two hours early tomorrow; that way you will definitely succeed in buying it.

repairs.note: 買不成 means unable to purchase, contradicting 絕對 (definitely).
沒買成 describes a past failure, but this is a future assurance.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 買得成.

items.prompt: Concert tickets sold out for this week. Mention we couldn't watch:

segments.traditional: 這個星期的戶外音樂會，票全賣完了。

result.traditional: 這週我們沒看成，下週票我訂好了，一定能去！
result.simplified: 这周我们没看成，下周票我订好了，一定能去！
result.pinyin: Zhè zhōu wǒmen méi kànchéng, xià zhōu piào wǒ dìng hǎo le, yídìng néng qù!
result.english: We didn't get to watch it this week; I've booked next week's tickets so we can definitely go!

repairs.note: 看成了 means watched successfully, contradicting sold-out tickets.
看得成 expresses affirmative possibility, which wasn't true this week.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 沒看成.

dialogue.title: 馬丁的環島旅行

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁的好兄弟尚恩在臺灣學習中文，他常寄臺灣的明信片給馬丁。明信片上有的是有名的景點，像臺北101、太魯閣、孔廟；有的是臺灣文化的代表，像寺廟、歌仔戲、夜市小吃等等。
lines.simplified: 马丁的好兄弟尚恩在台湾学习中文，他常寄台湾的明信片给马丁。明信片上有的是有名的景点，像台北101、太鲁阁、孔庙；有的是台湾文化的代表，像寺庙、歌仔戏、夜市小吃等等。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng de hǎo xiōngdì Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, tā cháng jì Táiwān de míngxìnpiàn gěi Mǎdīng. Míngxìnpiàn shàng yǒudeshì yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, xiàng Táiběi 101, Tàilǔgé, Kǒngmiào; yǒudeshì Táiwān wénhuà de dàibiǎo, xiàng sìmiào, gēzǎixì, yèshì xiǎochī děngděng.
lines.english: Narrator: Martin's close pal Shawn was studying Chinese in Taiwan and often mailed Taiwan postcards to Martin. Some depicted famous attractions like Taipei 101, Taroko Gorge, and the Confucius Temple; others represented Taiwanese culture, such as temples, Taiwanese opera, and night market snacks.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁常聽尚恩提到跟臺灣相關的事。比如，臺灣曾經是荷蘭和日本等國家的殖民地；臺灣人和中國人都說中文，可是有一些詞的用法不太一樣；就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同，不過願意服務民眾的人，都比較容易當選。
lines.simplified: 马丁常听尚恩提到跟台湾相关的事。比如，台湾曾经是荷兰和日本等国家的殖民地；台湾人和中国人都说中文，可是有一些词的用法不太一样；就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同，不过愿意服务民众的人，都比较容易当选。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng cháng tīng Shàng'ēn tídào gēn Táiwān xiāngguān de shì. Bǐrú, Táiwān céngjīng shì Hélán hé Rìběn děng guójiā de zhímíndì; Táiwānrén hé Zhōngguórén dōu shuō Zhōngwén, kěshì yǒu yìxiē cí de yòngfǎ bú tài yíyàng; jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bù tóng, búguò yuànyì fúwù mínzhòng de rén, dōu bǐjiào róngyì dāngxuǎn.
lines.english: Martin often heard Shawn mention matters regarding Taiwan. For example, Taiwan had once been a colony of the Netherlands and Japan; both Taiwanese and mainland Chinese speak Chinese, but certain word usages differ; in terms of election culture, Taiwan and France are very different, though those willing to serve the public are more likely to get elected.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁覺得尚恩在臺灣的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要親自來確認一下，看看這個島是不是真的像尚恩說的那樣有意思。最近馬丁的工作不太順利，所以他決定給自己放個假，到離法國約一萬公里以外的臺灣走走。不僅要嚐嚐小吃，還計畫一個人騎自行車環島旅行。
lines.simplified: 马丁觉得尚恩在台湾的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要亲自来确认一下，看看这个岛是不是真的像尚恩说的那样有意思。最近马丁的工作不太顺利，所以他决定给自己放个假，到离法国约一万公里以外的台湾走走。不仅要尝尝小吃，还计划一个人骑自行车环岛旅行。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng juéde Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān de shēnghuó hěn yǒu yìsi, tā xiǎng, yǒu yì tiān yídìng yào qīnzì lái quèrèn yíxià, kànkan zhè ge dǎo shì bú shì zhēnde xiàng Shàng'ēn shuō de nàyàng yǒu yìsi. Zuìjìn Mǎdīng de gōngzuò bú tài shùnlì, suǒyǐ tā juédìng gěi zìjǐ fàng ge jià, dào lí Fǎguó yuē yí wàn gōnglǐ yǐwài de Táiwān zǒuzou. Bùjǐn yào chángchang xiǎochī, hái jìhuà yí ge rén qí zìxíngchē huándǎo lǚxíng.
lines.english: Martin found Shawn's life in Taiwan fascinating and felt that one day he must come personally verify if this island was really as intriguing as Shawn described. Recently Martin's work wasn't going smoothly, so he decided to take a holiday and visit Taiwan, some 10,000 kilometers away from France. He planned not only to taste local snacks, but also to cycle around the island alone.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 其實馬丁剛到臺灣時，還忘不了工作的問題，所以心情不太好。但是，當他在東部又寬又平的公路上，邊騎著自行車，邊欣賞美麗的風景時，他忽然覺得就像在天堂一樣，太美好、太值得了！還有一次，馬丁坐在椅子上，很專心地看著寺廟前的歌仔戲表演。演員演出時，剛好穿著和明信片上一樣的服裝，那種熟悉的感覺讓他很興奮，立刻拿起相機拍了起來。這段時間他也認識了一些樂觀、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、開玩笑，讓他開心得把工作的問題都忘了。馬丁覺得在臺灣經驗過的這些美好生活，就是這次旅行最珍貴的紀念。
lines.simplified: 其实马丁刚到台湾时，还忘不了工作的问题，所以心情不太好。但是，当他在东部又宽又平的公路上，边骑着自行车，边欣赏美丽的风景时，他忽然觉得就像在天堂一样，太美好、太值得了！还有一次，马丁坐在椅子上，很专心地看着寺庙前的歌仔戏表演。演员演出时，刚好穿着和明信片上一样的服装，那种熟悉的感觉让他很兴奋，立刻拿起相机拍了起来。这段时间他也认识了一些乐观、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、开玩笑，让他开心得把工作的问题都忘了。马丁觉得在台湾经验过的这些美好生活，就是这次旅行最珍贵的纪念。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí Mǎdīng gāng dào Táiwān shí, hái wàng buliǎo gōngzuò de wèntí, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bú tài hǎo. Dànshì, dāng tā zài dōngbù yòu kuān yòu píng de gōnglù shàng, biān qí zhe zìxíngchē, biān xīnshǎng měilì de fēngjǐng shí, tā hūrán juéde jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yíyàng, tài měihǎo, tài zhídé le! Hái yǒu yí cì, Mǎdīng zuò zài yǐzi shàng, hěn zhuānxīn de kàn zhe sìmiào qián de gēzǎixì biǎoyǎn. Yǎnyuán yǎnchū shí, gānghǎo chuān zhe hé míngxìnpiàn shàng yíyàng de fúzhuāng, nà zhǒng shóuxī de gǎnjué ràng tā hěn xīngfèn, lìkè ná qǐ xiàngjī pāi le qǐlai. Zhè duàn shíjiān tā yě rènshí le yìxiē lèguān, yōumò de péngyou, dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān, kāiwánxiào, ràng tā kāixīn de bǎ gōngzuò de wèntí dōu wàng le. Mǎdīng juéde zài Táiwān jīngyàn guò de zhèxiē měihǎo shēnghuó, jiùshì zhè cì lǚxíng zuì zhēnguì de jìniàn.
lines.english: Actually when Martin first arrived, he couldn't put work troubles out of mind and was in a low mood. But as he cycled along wide flat highways in eastern Taiwan while admiring the breathtaking scenery, he suddenly felt like he was in paradise—it was wonderful and so worthwhile! Another time, sitting on a chair, he watched a Taiwanese opera performance in front of a temple attentively. The actors were dressed in the exact costumes shown on the postcards; that familiar feeling thrilled him, and he immediately snapped photos. During this trip he also befriended optimistic, humorous companions whose chats and jokes made him forget his work stress. Martin felt these wonderful experiences were the most precious souvenirs of the trip.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 經過這趟豐富的旅行後，馬丁的心情好多了，想法也改變了。回到法國後，到底要換新工作，還是要克服困難勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳選擇，讓生活過得更充實、更有意義。
lines.simplified: 经过这趟丰富的旅行后，马丁的心情好多了，想法也改变了。回到法国后，到底要换新工作，还是要克服困难勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳选择，让生活过得更充实、更有意义。
lines.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè tàng fēngfù de lǚxíng hòu, Mǎdīng de xīnqíng hǎo duō le, xiǎngfǎ yě gǎibiàn le. Huí dào Fǎguó hòu, dàodǐ yào huàn xīn gōngzuò, háishì yào kèfú kùnnan yǒnggǎn zǒu xiàqu, tā xiāngxìn zìjǐ yídìng néng zuòchū zuìjiā xuǎnzé, ràng shēnghuó guò de gèng chōngshí, gèng yǒu yìyì.
lines.english: After this enriching journey, Martin felt much better and his outlook shifted. Upon returning to France, whether to switch jobs or face difficulties bravely, he was confident he could make the best choice to make his life more fulfilling and meaningful.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: In Terms of / Speaking From the Standpoint of...
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Frame an analytical point from a specific scope or standpoint using 就……來說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「就……來說」常用在書面語中，「就」有針對的意思，用來引出說話者針對某個特定範圍、對象或角度進行的敘述、比較或分析。
grammarPages.pattern: 就 + Domain / Scope + 來說，Statement

text.traditional: 就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同。
text.simplified: 就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同。
text.pinyin: Jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bù tóng.
text.english: In terms of election culture, Taiwan and France are very different.

text.traditional: 就購物的方式來說，使用網路不僅方便，比價也容易多了。
text.simplified: 就购物的方式来说，使用网络不仅方便，比价也容易多了。
text.pinyin: Jiù gòuwù de fāngshì lái shuō, shǐyòng wǎnglù bùjǐn fāngbiàn, bǐjià yě róngyì duō le.
text.english: In terms of shopping methods, using the internet is not only convenient, but price comparison is much easier.

text.traditional: 就我們系的課程來說，不僅一學期比一學期難，報告也變多了。
text.simplified: 就我们系的课程来说，不仅一学期比一学期难，报告也变多了。
text.pinyin: Jiù wǒmen xì de kèchéng lái shuō, bùjǐn yì xuéqī bǐ yì xuéqī nán, bàogào yě biàn duō le.
text.english: In terms of our department's courses, not only is each semester harder than the last, but reports have also increased.

items.question: How does 就……來說 differ from 對……來說?
items.answer: 就……來說 targets a specific objective domain or criteria ('in terms of X'). 對……來說 introduces an individual's personal subjective perspective ('to person X').
items.wrongTraditional: 對選舉文化來說，兩國很不同。
items.wrongSimplified: 对选举文化来说，两国很不同。

right.traditional: 就選舉文化來說，兩國很不同。
right.simplified: 就选举文化来说，两国很不同。
right.pinyin: Jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, liǎng guó hěn bù tóng.
right.english: In terms of election culture, the two countries are very different.

items.question: Can 來說 be replaced with 看 in this pattern?
items.answer: 來說 is standard in this written construction; do not use 看 or other verbs inside the frame.
items.wrongTraditional: 就這棟房子的環境來看說，還不錯。
items.wrongSimplified: 就这栋房子的环境来看说，还不错。

right.traditional: 就這棟房子的環境來說，還不錯。
right.simplified: 就这栋房子的环境来说，还不错。
right.pinyin: Jiù zhè dòng fángzi de huánjìng lái shuō, hái búcuò.
right.english: In terms of this house's environment, it's pretty good.

questions.prompt: Introduce a critique framed from the standpoint of product quality:
questions.correctFeedback: 就……來說 evaluates an objective domain or quality.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 就……來說 to scope analysis by a specific standard or domain.

items.prompt: Evaluate apartment. State that surrounding environment is good:

segments.traditional: 你剛剛看的那棟房子怎麼樣？
說還不錯，不過價錢有點高。

result.traditional: 就環境來說還不錯，不過價錢有點高。
result.simplified: 就环境来说还不错，不过价钱有点高。
result.pinyin: Jiù huánjìng lái shuō hái búcuò, búguò jiàqián yǒudiǎn gāo.
result.english: In terms of environment it's pretty good, but the price is a bit high.

repairs.note: 對 marks personal attitude toward something, not an objective angle of analysis.
從 indicates origin or direction, not criteria framing with 來說.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 就環境來.

items.prompt: Review toy factory. Praise production equipment:

segments.traditional: 你覺得昨天參觀的那家玩具工廠怎麼樣？
說，他們採用了最先進的技術。

result.traditional: 就設備來說，他們採用了最先進的技術。
result.simplified: 就设备来说，他们采用了最先进的技术。
result.pinyin: Jiù shèbèi lái shuō, tāmen cǎiyòng le zuì xiānjìn de jìshù.
result.english: In terms of equipment, they adopted the most advanced technology.

repairs.note: 向 indicates physical orientation.
在 indicates spatial or temporal presence, not analytical framing.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 就設備來.

items.prompt: Explain why you chose this city in terms of living quality:

segments.traditional: 你為什麼選擇在這個城市定居？
質來說，這裡非常舒適又便利。

result.traditional: 就生活品質來說，這裡非常舒適又便利。
result.simplified: 就生活品质来说，这里非常舒适又便利。
result.pinyin: Jiù shēnghuó pǐnzhì lái shuō, zhèlǐ fēicháng shūshì yòu biànlì.
result.english: In terms of quality of life, it's very comfortable and convenient here.

repairs.note: 把 is an object-disposal marker, not an analytical preposition.
被 marks passive voice.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 就生活品.

items.prompt: Describe an optimistic, active friend in terms of personality:

segments.traditional: 大家都很喜歡小林，他是個什麼樣的人？
說，他非常樂觀開朗，喜歡挑戰。

result.traditional: 就個性來說，他非常樂觀開朗，喜歡挑戰。
result.simplified: 就个性来说，他非常乐观开朗，喜欢挑战。
result.pinyin: Jiù gèxìng lái shuō, tā fēicháng lèguān kāilǎng, xǐhuan tiǎozhàn.
result.english: In terms of personality, he is very optimistic, cheerful, and loves challenges.

repairs.note: 看 is not used inside the 就……來說 frame.
聽 does not introduce an analytical scope.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 就個性來.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Degree Complement: Result or Extreme Extent
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Depict vivid or extreme results of an action or state using V/Vs得.
grammarPages.explanation: 「得」的後面是補語，用來詳細說明前面動作（V）或狀態（Vs）所達到的程度或造成的結果。常用生動、誇張的短句進行描寫，如「吃得站不起來」、「忙得沒時間上廁所」。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb / Stative Verb + 得 + Degree / Vivid Consequence

text.traditional: 大家一起聊天開玩笑，讓他開心得把工作的問題都忘了。
text.simplified: 大家一起聊天开玩笑，让他开心得把工作的问题都忘了。
text.pinyin: Dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān kāiwánxiào, ràng tā kāixīn de bǎ gōngzuò de wèntí dōu wàng le.
text.english: Everyone chatted and joked together, making him so happy he forgot his work troubles.

words.pinyin: bǎ gōngzuò wèntí dōu wàng le

text.traditional: 我在那家吃到飽餐廳吃了一連四個小時，吃得我都站不起來了。
text.simplified: 我在那家吃到饱餐厅吃了一连四个小时，吃得我都站不起来了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài nà jiā chīdàobǎo cāntīng chī le yìlián sì ge xiǎoshí, chī de wǒ dōu zhàn bu qǐlai le.
text.english: I ate for four hours straight at that buffet, eating so much I couldn't even stand up.

text.traditional: 那家包子店的生意好得不得了，店員忙得沒時間吃飯。
text.simplified: 那家包子店的生意好得不得了，店员忙得没时间吃饭。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā bāozidiàn de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo, diànyuán máng de méi shíjiān chīfàn.
text.english: That bun shop's business is extraordinarily good; clerks are so busy they have no time to eat.

items.question: Which 得 particle connects verbs to degree complements?
items.answer: Use 得 (structural particle for complements), not 的 (noun modifier) or 地 (adverbial marker).
items.wrongTraditional: 他開心的大笑了起來。
items.wrongSimplified: 他开心的大笑了起来。

right.traditional: 他開心得大笑了起來。
right.simplified: 他开心得大笑了起来。
right.pinyin: Tā kāixīn de dàxiào le qǐlai.
right.english: He was so happy that he started laughing out loud.

items.question: Can V/Vs得 be followed by a full explanatory clause?
items.answer: Yes, it frequently introduces an exaggerated consequence clause like 我都站不起來了 or 沒時間吃飯.
items.wrongTraditional: 他忙的連飯都沒吃完。
items.wrongSimplified: 他忙的连饭都没吃完。

right.traditional: 他忙得連飯都沒吃完。
right.simplified: 他忙得连饭都没吃完。
right.pinyin: Tā máng de lián fàn dōu méi chīwán.
right.english: He was so busy that he didn't even finish his meal.

questions.prompt: Describe intense leg pain after an all-day soccer match:

segments.hint: hurt so much I couldn't walk

tiles.pinyin: tòng de zǒu bú dòng le
tòng de zǒu bú dòng le
tòng de zǒu bú dòng le

questions.correctFeedback: 得 links the stative predicate 痛 to the degree complement 走不動了.
questions.repairFeedback: Use the complement particle 得 to connect predicate to degree result.

items.prompt: After playing soccer all day, describe foot pain that prevents walking:

segments.traditional: 踢了一整天足球，腳很痛吧？

result.traditional: 是啊，腳痛得我連路都走不動了。
result.simplified: 是啊，脚痛得我连路都走不动了。
result.pinyin: Shì a, jiǎo tòng de wǒ lián lù dōu zǒu bú dòng le.
result.english: Yeah, my feet hurt so much that I can't even walk.

repairs.note: 的 is a noun-attributive marker, not the complement particle 得.
地 is an adverbial marker, not the complement particle 得.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 腳痛得我.

items.prompt: Upstairs neighbors sang late karaoke. Describe sleepless noise:

segments.traditional: 你以前住的那間公寓怎麼樣？
晚睡不著，後來我就搬家了。

result.traditional: 樓上鄰居常夜裡唱歌，吵得我整晚睡不著，後來我就搬家了。
result.simplified: 楼上邻居常夜里唱歌，吵得我整晚睡不着，后来我就搬家了。
result.pinyin: Lóushàng línjū cháng yèlǐ chànggē, chǎo de wǒ zhěng wǎn shuì bu zháo, hòulái wǒ jiù bānjiā le.
result.english: Upstairs neighbors often sang late at night; it was so noisy I couldn't sleep all night, so I moved.

repairs.note: Use 得 to connect the stative verb 吵 to the degree clause.
地 is an adverbial marker, not complement 得.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 吵得我整.

items.prompt: Ate very spicy food by accident. Describe streaming tears:

segments.traditional: 聽說你怕吃辣，只要有一點辣就吃不下？
流眼淚，趕快喝了好多水。

result.traditional: 是啊，才吃一口就辣得我直流眼淚，趕快喝了好多水。
result.simplified: 是啊，才吃一口就辣得我直流眼泪，赶快喝了好多水。
result.pinyin: Shì a, cái chī yì kǒu jiù là de wǒ zhí liú yǎnlèi, gǎnkuài hē le hǎoduō shuǐ.
result.english: Yes, after barely one bite it was so spicy tears streamed down, and I hurried to drink water.

repairs.note: Use 得 for the degree complement after 辣.
地 modifies verbs adverbially, not degree outcomes.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 辣得我直.

items.prompt: Outdoor concert atmosphere. Describe extraordinary excitement:

segments.traditional: 昨晚樂團的戶外演唱會現場氣氛怎麼樣？
得了，大家跟著一起唱歌！

result.traditional: 放煙火時，現場熱鬧得不得了，大家跟著一起唱歌！
result.simplified: 放烟火时，现场热闹得不得了，大家跟着一起唱歌！
result.pinyin: Fàng yānhuǒ shí, xiànchǎng rènào de bùdéliǎo, dàjiā gēnzhe yìqǐ chànggē!
result.english: When fireworks went off, the scene was lively beyond belief, and everyone sang along!

repairs.note: 得不得了 is the degree complement formula, requiring 得.
地 cannot pair with 不得了.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 熱鬧得不.

dialogue.title: 穿著和品味
grammarFocus: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 朋子，妳最近穿衣服的風格跟以前很不一樣，名牌衣服怎麼不穿了呢？
lines.simplified: 朋子，你最近穿衣服的风格跟以前很不一样，名牌衣服怎么不穿了呢？
lines.pinyin: Péngzǐ, nǐ zuìjìn chuān yīfú de fēnggé gēn yǐqián hěn bù yíyàng, míngpái yīfú zěnme bù chuān le ne?
lines.english: Tomoko, your clothing style lately is very different from before. How come you don't wear brand-name clothes anymore?

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我想改變別人對我的看法。以前，我的穿著容易讓人產生誤會，以為我是個不好相處的人。
lines.simplified: 我想改变别人对我的看法。以前，我的穿着容易让人产生误会，以为我是个不好相处的人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gǎibiàn biérén duì wǒ de kànfǎ. Yǐqián, wǒ de chuānzhuó róngyì ràng rén chǎnshēng wùhuì, yǐwéi wǒ shì ge bù hǎo xiāngchǔ de rén.
lines.english: I want to change what people think of me. In the past, my dressing easily gave people misunderstandings, assuming I was hard to get along with.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 說真的，剛認識妳的時候，妳從頭到腳都是名牌，總是覺得我們有一段距離。
lines.simplified: 说真的，刚认识你的时候，你从头到脚都是名牌，总是觉得我们有一段距离。
lines.pinyin: Shuō zhēn de, gāng rènshì nǐ de shíhòu, nǐ cóng tóu dào jiǎo dōushì míngpái, zǒngshì juéde wǒmen yǒu yí duàn jùlí.
lines.english: Honestly, when I first met you, you wore designer labels from head to toe, and I always felt a distance between us.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 唉！不用說也知道你會這麼想。其實這跟我爸媽有關，他們對穿衣服很講究，也覺得穿名牌才有品味，所以影響了我對穿著的看法。
lines.simplified: 唉！不用说也知道你会这么想。其实这跟我爸妈有关，他们对穿衣服很讲究，也觉得穿名牌才有品味，所以影响了我对穿着的看法。
lines.pinyin: Ài! Búyòng shuō yě zhīdào nǐ huì zhème xiǎng. Qíshí zhè gēn wǒ bàmā yǒuguān, tāmen duì chuān yīfú hěn jiǎngjiù, yě juéde chuān míngpái cái yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ yǐngxiǎng le wǒ duì chuānzhuó de kànfǎ.
lines.english: Sigh! It goes without saying you'd think that. Actually this has to do with my parents; they are very particular about clothing and feel only designer clothes have taste, so that influenced my view on dressing.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 妳爸媽的朋友，不是大老闆就是政治人物，有這樣的想法很自然啊！合適的穿著對他們很重要，名牌衣服才能表現出他們的地位。
lines.simplified: 你爸妈的朋友，不是大老板就是政治人物，有这样的想法很自然啊！合适的人穿着对他们很重要，名牌衣服才能表现出他们的地位。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàmā de péngyǒu, búshì dà lǎobǎn jiùshì zhèngzhì rénwù, yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ hěn zìrán a! Héshì de chuānzhuó duì tāmen hěn zhòngyào, míngpái yīfú cái néng biǎoxiàn chū tāmen de dìwèi.
lines.english: Your parents' friends are either big bosses or political figures, so having that mindset is quite natural! Appropriate attire is very important for them; designer clothing expresses their status.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 你說的沒錯，可是我還是不希望大家把我看成只愛買名牌的人。
lines.simplified: 你说得没错，可是我还是不希望大家把我看成只爱买名牌的人。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò, kěshì wǒ háishì bù xīwàng dàjiā bǎ wǒ kànchéng zhǐ ài mǎi míngpái de rén.
lines.english: What you said is true, but I still don't want everyone to look at me as someone who only cares about buying luxury brands.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 跟以前比起來，妳現在的穿著更能表現出個人的特色。
lines.simplified: 跟以前比起来，你现在的穿着更能表现出个人的特色。
lines.pinyin: Gēn yǐqián bǐ qǐlái, nǐ xiànzài de chuānzhuó gèng néng biǎoxiàn chū gèrén de tèsè.
lines.english: Compared to before, your dressing now expresses your personal character much better.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 以前我和朋友聊天的話題，常常是哪些服裝很流行，哪個名牌又請了大明星拍廣告什麼的，現在我只想穿得舒適，又有屬於自己的風格，是不是名牌真的無所謂。
lines.simplified: 以前我和朋友聊天的话题，常常是哪些服装很流行，哪个名牌又请了大明星拍广告什么的，现在我只想穿得舒适，又有属于自己的风格，是不是名牌真的无所谓。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ hé péngyǒu liáotiān de huàtí, chángcháng shì nǎxiē fúzhuāng hěn liúxíng, nǎge míngpái yòu qǐng le dà míngxīng pāi guǎnggào shénmede, xiànzài wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chuān de shūshì, yòu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de fēnggé, shì bú shì míngpái zhēn de wúsuǒwèi.
lines.english: In the past, topics when chatting with friends were often about which clothes were trendy, or which brand hired a celebrity for an ad. Now I just want to dress comfortably and have my own style; whether it's a name brand really doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 一般來說，明星的穿著都會吸引大家注意，所以服裝公司才會花大錢請明星拍廣告，這是正常的商業作法。其實多了解一些流行的現象也沒什麼不好。
lines.simplified: 一般来说，明星的穿着都会吸引大家注意，所以服装公司才会花大钱请明星拍广告，这是正常的商业作法。其实多了解一些流行的现象也没什么不好。
lines.pinyin: Yìbān láishuō, míngxīng de chuānzhuó dōu huì xīyǐn dàjiā zhùyì, suǒyǐ fúzhuāng gōngsī cái huì huā dà qián qǐng míngxīng pāi guǎnggào, zhè shì zhèngcháng de shāngyè zuòfǎ. Qíshí duō liǎojiě yìxiē liúxíng de xiànxiàng yě méi shénme bù hǎo.
lines.english: Generally speaking, celebrities' attire draws attention, so apparel companies spend big money to hire stars for commercials; that's a normal commercial practice. Actually, understanding fashion trends isn't a bad thing either.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 嗯，問題是流行的穿著不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也應該找到自己的風格。
lines.simplified: 嗯，问题是流行的穿着不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也应该找到自己的风格。
lines.pinyin: Èn, wèntí shì liúxíng de chuānzhuó bù yídìng jiù yǒu pǐnwèi, zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliang de rén yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé.
lines.english: Mm, the issue is that trendy dressing doesn't necessarily have good taste. No matter how handsome or pretty someone is, they should still find their own style.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我同意妳的說法。想穿出自己的風格，可以多看看專櫃跟雜誌上流行的服裝，想像穿在自己身上的樣子。過些時間，就能抓到感覺了。
lines.simplified: 我同意你的说法。想穿出自己的风格，可以多看看专柜跟杂志上流行的服装，想象穿在自己身上的样子。过些时间，就能抓到感觉了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de shuōfǎ. Xiǎng chuān chū zìjǐ de fēnggé, kěyǐ duō kànkan zhuānguì gēn zázhì shàng liúxíng de fúzhuāng, xiǎngxiàng chuān zài zìjǐ shēnshang de yàngzi. Guò xiē shíjiān, jiù néng zhuādào gǎnjué le.
lines.english: I agree with what you said. If you want to dress with personal style, browse department counters and fashion magazines, and imagine what looks good on you. In time, you'll catch the feeling.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 不過也不能只跟著流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有幾個朋友跟我剛好相反，他們不僅天天穿名牌，也常上街買衣服，什麼流行就買什麼，好像花多少錢都沒有限制。
lines.simplified: 不过也不能只跟着流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有几个朋友跟我刚好相反，他们不仅天天穿名牌，也常上街买衣服，什么流行就买什么，好像花多少钱都没有限制。
lines.pinyin: Búguò yě bù néng zhǐ gēnzhe liúxíng, yídìng yào yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge péngyǒu gēn wǒ gānghǎo xiāngfǎn, tāmen bùjǐn tiāntiān chuān míngpái, yě cháng shàngjiē mǎi yīfú, shénme liúxíng jiù mǎi shénme, hǎoxiàng huā duōshao qián dōu méiyǒu xiànzhì.
lines.english: Still, one shouldn't just follow trends; you must have your own perspective. I have a few friends who are the exact opposite of me: not only do they wear designer clothes every day, but they often go shopping, buying whatever is trendy, as if there is no spending limit.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 難怪大家都說女孩子的櫃子裡永遠少一件衣服。
lines.simplified: 难怪大家都说女孩子的柜子里永远少一件衣服。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài dàjiā dōu shuō nǚhái zǐ de guìzi lǐ yǒngyuǎn shǎo yí jiàn yīfú.
lines.english: No wonder everyone says a woman's wardrobe is always missing one piece of clothing.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去買；現在，我了解自己真正的需要是什麼，絕對不會亂買了。
lines.simplified: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去买；现在，我了解自己真正的需要是什么，绝对不会乱买了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kě bú shì ō! Yǐqián, yì yǒu xīn shāngpǐn wǒ jiù qù mǎi; xiànzài, wǒ liǎojiě zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de xūyào shì shénme, juéduì bú huì luàn mǎi le.
lines.english: Not me, though! In the past, as soon as a new product came out I went to buy it; now, I understand what my real needs are, and I definitely won't buy recklessly.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 其實穿衣服也是個學問。名牌衣服，有的人穿起來好看，有的人穿起來可能很醜呢！
lines.simplified: 其实穿衣服也是个学问。名牌衣服，有的人穿起来好看，有的人穿起来可能很丑呢！
lines.pinyin: Qíshí chuān yīfú yě shì ge xuéwèn. Míngpái yīfú, yǒu de rén chuān qǐlái hǎokàn, yǒu de rén chuān qǐlái kěnéng hěn chǒu ne!
lines.english: Actually, dressing well is a skill in itself. Brand-name clothes look great on some people, but on others they can look quite ugly!

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 沒錯。對我來說，只要穿得慣、穿得自在，把自己當衣服的主人，這樣就能對自己更有信心了。
lines.simplified: 没错。对我来说，只要穿得惯、穿得自在，把自己当衣服的主人，这样就能对自己更有信心了。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò. Duì wǒ láishuō, zhǐyào chuān de guàn, chuān de zìzài, bǎ zìjǐ dāng yīfú de zhǔrén, zhèyàng jiù néng duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn le.
lines.english: Exactly. To me, as long as I feel accustomed and at ease wearing them, treating myself as the master of the clothes, that's how I gain more self-confidence.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 妳本來條件就好，加上穿著又變得這麼有品味，難怪越來越有魅力了。
lines.simplified: 你本来条件就好，加上穿着又变得这么有品味，难怪越来越有魅力了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ běnlái tiáojiàn jiù hǎo, jiāshàng chuānzhuó yòu biànde zhème yǒu pǐnwèi, nánguài yuèláiyuè yǒu mèilì le.
lines.english: You naturally have great qualities, and now that your attire has become so tasteful, no wonder you're growing more charming by the day.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 別開玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
lines.simplified: 别开玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
lines.pinyin: Bié kāi wánxiào le, nǐ de pǐnwèi bǐ wǒ gèng hǎo ne!
lines.english: Stop joking, your taste is even better than mine!

grammarPages.titleTraditional: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Transforming or Misinterpreting with 把...V成...
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how someone transforms one thing into another, or mistakes one thing for another.
grammarPages.explanation: 「成」有「成為」、「變成」的意思。表示某人經由某個動作，讓 NP1 成為或變成 NP2。如果動詞是「看、聽、說、寫、念」，有時有「弄錯了」的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + NP1 + Verb + 成 + NP2

items.prompt: A suggests writing a novel based on blog entries. Complete B's response about turning travel notes into a book:

segments.traditional: 我常看你的部落格，內容很充實，可以寫小說了。
謝謝！我正打算把旅遊經驗

result.traditional: 謝謝！我正打算把旅遊經驗寫成一本書。
result.simplified: 谢谢！我正打算把旅游经验写成一本书。
result.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ zhèng dǎsuàn bǎ lǚyóu jīngyàn xiěchéng yì běn shū.
result.english: Thanks! I'm actually planning to turn my travel experiences into a book.

repairs.note: Use 寫成 ('write into / transform into a work'), not 寫到 (which denotes physical destination or degree).
看成 means to view or mistake as, not to write and produce a book.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 寫成.

items.prompt: A confuses similar characters. Complete B's confession about mistaking 白 for 自:

segments.traditional: 「白」跟「自」這兩個字太像了，我老是弄錯。

result.traditional: 嗯。我也常把「白」看成「自」。
result.simplified: 嗯。我也常把「白」看成「自」。
result.pinyin: Èn. Wǒ yě cháng bǎ "bái" kànchéng "zì".
result.english: Yeah. I also often mistake "bai" for "zi".

repairs.note: To express visually mistaking one character for another, use 把...看成..., not 看見 ('to see').
看成 specifically denotes confusing or mistaking one object for another.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 看成.

items.prompt: Seven people gifted a birthday cake. Complete B's reply about dividing it evenly:

segments.traditional: 這是我們七個人一起送你的蛋糕。祝你生日快樂！

result.traditional: 謝謝！我把它切成七塊，剛好一人一塊。
result.simplified: 谢谢！我把它切成七块，刚好一人一块。
result.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ bǎ tā qiēchéng qī kuài, gānghǎo yì rén yí kuài.
result.english: Thank you! I'll cut it into seven slices, exactly one slice per person.

repairs.note: Use 成 to denote resulting divided pieces (切成), not a location 在.
The measure word for cake slices is 塊 (切成七塊).

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 切成七塊.

items.prompt: Friend's soup is too sweet because they confused sugar for salt. How do you ask them?

result.traditional: 你煮的湯好甜，是不是把糖放成鹽了？

result.pinyin: Nǐ zhǔ de tāng hǎo tián, shì bú shì bǎ táng fàngchéng yán le?
result.english: Your soup is so sweet, did you put in sugar instead of salt by mistake?

repairs.note: 放成 indicates mistakenly seasoning with sugar in place of salt (result complement 成).
The physical seasoning mistake was putting it in (放成), not merely looking.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 把糖放成.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: No Matter How Extreme with 再...也/都...
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that no matter how extreme an attribute or condition is, a decision or truth remains unchanged.
grammarPages.explanation: 「再……，也/都……」使用在假設的情況，有「就算……，也……」的意思。「再」後面的句子是把情況說到最高或最低、最好或最壞的程度，而「也」或「都」後面的結果、決定或是想法不會改變；有時候表示說話的人覺得應該而且值得這樣做。
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 再 + Stative Verb / Condition + 也/都 + Consequence

text.traditional: 再英俊、再漂亮的人也應該找到自己的風格。
text.simplified: 再英俊、再漂亮的人也应该找到自己的风格。
text.pinyin: Zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliang de rén yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé.
text.english: No matter how handsome or pretty someone is, they should still find their own style.

words.pinyin: zài yīngjùn zài piàoliang de rén

text.traditional: 孩子需要父母照顧，父母再忙都應該陪陪他們，了解他們的想法。
text.simplified: 孩子需要父母照顾，父母再忙都应该陪陪他们，了解他们的想法。
text.pinyin: Háizi xūyào fùmǔ zhàogù, fùmǔ zài máng dōu yīnggāi péipei tāmen, liǎojiě tāmen de xiǎngfǎ.
text.english: Children need care from parents; no matter how busy parents are, they should spend time with them and understand their thoughts.

text.traditional: 為了得到更多經驗，也為了美好的未來，再討厭的工作也得忍耐。
text.simplified: 为了得到更多经验，也为了美好的未来，再讨厌的工作也得忍耐。
text.pinyin: Wèile dédào gèng duō jīngyàn, yě wèile měihǎo de wèilái, zài tǎoyàn de gōngzuò yě děi rěnnài.
text.english: To gain more experience and for a brighter future, one must endure no matter how much one dislikes the job.

items.question: How do you say no matter how sweet a cookie is, you will still eat it?

items.wrongTraditional: 這是你做的，更甜我也要吃。

right.english: You made this, so no matter how sweet it is I'll still eat it.

items.wrongTraditional: 漢字又難寫也得練習。
items.wrongSimplified: 汉字又难写也得练习。

right.traditional: 漢字再難寫也得練習。
right.simplified: 汉字再难写也得练习。
right.pinyin: Hànzì zài nán xiě yě děi liànxí.
right.english: No matter how hard characters are to write, one must still practice.

questions.prompt: Express resolve to take the exam no matter how sick you feel:

segments.hint: no matter how unwell still must

questions.correctFeedback: 再……也 expresses that even at the extreme limit of feeling unwell, the obligation stands.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 再 + Adjective + 也 to express concessive extreme condition.

items.prompt: A advises staying home due to illness. Complete B's refusal because an exam is scheduled:

segments.traditional: 你要是覺得不舒服，就請假在家休息吧。

result.traditional: 不可以，今天有考試，再不舒服也得去學校。
result.simplified: 不可以，今天有考试，再不舒服也得去学校。
result.pinyin: Bù kěyǐ, jīntiān yǒu kǎoshì, zài bù shūfu yě děi qù xuéxiào.
result.english: No way, there's an exam today; no matter how unwell I feel, I must go to school.

repairs.note: Use 再 + Adjective + 也 to express 'no matter how uncomfortable'.
Use hypothetical concessive 再, not factual intensifier 很.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 再不舒服.

items.prompt: A baked sweet cookies. Express your willingness to taste them regardless of sweetness:

segments.traditional: 這是我做的巧克力餅乾，可能有點兒甜，嘗嘗嗎？
雖然我不愛吃甜點，但這是你做的，

result.traditional: 雖然我不愛吃甜點，但這是你做的，再甜我也要嘗嘗。
result.simplified: 虽然我不爱吃甜点，但这是你做的，再甜我也要尝尝。
result.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ bú ài chī tiándiǎn, dàn zhè shì nǐ zuò de, zài tián wǒ yě yào chángchang.
result.english: Although I don't love sweets, since you made this, no matter how sweet it is I'll still taste it.

repairs.note: Use hypothetical extreme 再甜...也... ('no matter how sweet'), not complaint 太甜.
Use 也 with an individual conditional action following 再甜.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 再甜我也.

items.prompt: A asks if a 12-hour flight to see your boyfriend is exhausting. Complete your reply:

segments.traditional: 聽說妳要坐十二小時飛機見男友，不累嗎？

result.traditional: 我們很久沒見面了，再累我也要去見他。
result.simplified: 我们很久没见面了，再累我也要去见他。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen hěn jiǔ méi jiànmiàn le, zài lèi wǒ yě yào qù jiàn tā.
result.english: We haven't seen each other in so long; no matter how tired I am, I still want to go see him.

repairs.note: Concessive extreme uses 再 ('no matter how tired'), not complaint 太.
Hypothetical condition paired with 也 uses 再, not comparative 更.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 再累我也.

items.prompt: A student finds characters hard to write. Encourage them that practice brings quick progress:

segments.traditional: 寫漢字中文才進步得快，漢字

result.traditional: 寫漢字中文才進步得快，漢字再難寫也得練習。
result.simplified: 写汉字中文才进步得快，汉字再难写也得练习。
result.pinyin: Xiě hànzì Zhōngwén cái jìnbù de kuài, hànzì zài nán xiě yě děi liànxí.
result.english: Writing characters makes your Chinese improve faster; no matter how hard characters are to write, one must still practice.

repairs.note: Use 再 + Stative Verb + 也 to set up the concessive condition.
Concessive hypothetical pattern uses 再, not 更.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Accustomed to Actions with V慣 / V得慣 / V不慣
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether you are used to doing an action, or can/cannot get accustomed to it.
grammarPages.explanation: 「動詞＋慣」的「慣」有習慣的意思，是結果補語，表示前面動作的結果。如果「慣」的前面加上「得/不」，表示前面的動作能或不能習慣。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + (得/不) + 慣 (+ Object)

text.traditional: 對我來說，只要穿得慣、穿得自在，把自己當衣服的主人，這樣就能對自己更有信心了。
text.simplified: 对我来说，只要穿得惯、穿得自在，把自己当衣服的主人，这样就能对自己更有信心了。
text.pinyin: Duì wǒ láishuō, zhǐyào chuān de guàn, chuān de zìzài, bǎ zìjǐ dāng yīfú de zhǔrén, zhèyàng jiù néng duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn le.
text.english: To me, as long as I feel accustomed and comfortable wearing them, making myself the master of the clothes, that's how I gain more self-confidence.

words.pinyin: zhǐyào chuān de guàn chuān de zìzài
bǎ zìjǐ dāng yīfú de zhǔrén
jiù néng duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn

text.traditional: 很多部落格都推薦那家餐廳，不過他們的菜鹹了點兒，我吃不慣。
text.simplified: 很多部落格都推荐那家餐厅，不过他们的菜咸了点儿，我吃不惯。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō bùluògé dōu tuījiàn nà jiā cāntīng, búguò tāmen de cài xián le diǎnr, wǒ chībúguàn.
text.english: Many blogs recommend that restaurant, but their dishes are a bit too salty; I can't get used to eating them.

words.traditional: 不過他們的菜鹹了點兒
words.simplified: 不过他们的菜咸了点儿
words.pinyin: búguò tāmen de cài xián le diǎnr

text.traditional: 我睡慣了家裡的床，旅館的床睡不慣。
text.simplified: 我睡惯了家里的床，旅馆的床睡不惯。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shuìguàn le jiā lǐ de chuáng, lǚguǎn de chuáng shuìbúguàn.
text.english: I am used to sleeping in my bed at home; I can't get used to sleeping on hotel beds.

words.meaning: I am used to sleeping in

items.question: How do you say you cannot get accustomed to eating natto?
items.answer: 那種獨特的味道，我吃不慣。
items.wrongTraditional: 那種獨特的味道，我吃不習慣了。
items.wrongSimplified: 那种独特的味道，我吃不习惯了。

right.traditional: 那種獨特的味道，我吃不慣。
right.simplified: 那种独特的味道，我吃不惯。
right.pinyin: Nà zhǒng dútè de wèidào, wǒ chībúguàn.
right.english: That unique taste, I just can't get used to eating it.

items.question: How do you explain moving because you cannot get used to living in a noisy place?
items.answer: 這裡太吵了，我住不慣。
items.wrongTraditional: 這裡太吵了，我住沒慣。
items.wrongSimplified: 这里太吵了，我住没惯。

right.traditional: 這裡太吵了，我住不慣。
right.simplified: 这里太吵了，我住不惯。
right.pinyin: Zhèlǐ tài chǎo le, wǒ zhùbúguàn.

questions.prompt: Say that you cannot adapt to driving a new car model:

segments.traditional: 這部車的方向盤怪怪的，我

questions.correctFeedback: 開不慣 denotes negative potential result: unable to get used to driving.
questions.repairFeedback: Use Verb + 不慣 to express inability to get accustomed to an action.

items.prompt: A asks if you can stomach natto in Japan. Complete B's response about being unable to get used to it:

segments.traditional: 你住在日本一段時間了，吃得慣納豆嗎？
那種獨特的味道，我到現在還是

result.traditional: 那種獨特的味道，我到現在還是吃不慣。
result.simplified: 那种独特的味道，我到现在还是吃不惯。
result.pinyin: Nà zhǒng dútè de wèidào, wǒ dào xiànzài háishì chībúguàn.
result.english: That unique taste, even now I still can't get used to eating it.

repairs.note: The context indicates an inability to adapt; use negative potential 吃不慣.
Potential complements take 不 (吃不慣), never 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 吃不慣.

items.prompt: A asks not to be called 'Miss Lin' anymore. Complete B's apology about an ingrained habit:

segments.traditional: 我們已經認識快一年了，別再叫我「林小姐」了。

result.traditional: 對不起，我平時叫慣了，一時改不過來。
result.simplified: 对不起，我平时叫惯了，一时改不过来。
result.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ píngshí jiàoguàn le, yìshí gǎibùguòlái.
result.english: Sorry, I'm used to calling you that and can't change overnight.

repairs.note: 叫得慣 is potential ('can get used to'); here an established habit is affirmed with 叫慣了.
The textbook result complement pattern is V慣了 (叫慣了).

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 叫慣了.

items.prompt: Friend recommends high heels, but you find them too high. Tell your friend you can't wear them comfortably:

segments.traditional: 這雙皮鞋跟太高了，我平時

result.traditional: 這雙皮鞋跟太高了，我平時穿不慣這麼高的鞋。
result.simplified: 这双皮鞋跟太高了，我平时穿不惯这么高的鞋。
result.pinyin: Zhè shuāng píxié gēn tài gāo le, wǒ píngshí chuānbúguàn zhème gāo de xié.
result.english: The heels on these leather shoes are too high; I'm ordinarily not used to wearing shoes this high.

repairs.note: You are declining because you cannot comfortably walk in them (穿不慣).
Negative potential complement takes 不 (穿不慣), never 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 穿不慣.

items.prompt: Colleague wonders why you're moving from a convenient apartment. Explain the intolerable noise:

segments.traditional: 雖然離公司很近，但是這裡環境太吵，我實在

result.traditional: 雖然離公司很近，但是這裡環境太吵，我實在住不慣。
result.simplified: 虽然离公司很近，但是这里环境太吵，我实在住不惯。
result.pinyin: Suīrán lí gōngsī hěn jìn, dànshì zhèlǐ huánjìng tài chǎo, wǒ shízài zhùbúguàn.
result.english: Although it's close to the company, the surroundings here are too noisy; I really can't get used to living here.

repairs.note: 住得慣 expresses being able to adapt; here you cannot tolerate the noise (住不慣).
Negative potential complement takes 不 (住不慣), never 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 住不慣.

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · Fast Fashion and Rational Choices

dialogue.title: 快時尚

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 東賢以前是模特兒，他曾經和一家服裝公司合作，為推銷新產品拍廣告。廣告播出以後，商品賣得非常好。但是，過不了多久，就有樣式更新、更吸引人的服裝出來了。這種「快時尚」的現象，對民眾的生活產生了很大的影響。
lines.simplified: 东贤以前是模特儿，他曾经和一家服装公司合作，为推销新产品拍广告。广告播出以后，商品卖得非常好。但是，过不了多久，就有样式更新、更吸引人的服装出来了。这种「快时尚」的现象，对民众的生活产生了很大的影响。
lines.pinyin: Dōngxián yǐqián shì mótèr, tā céngjīng hé yì jiā fúzhuāng gōngsī hézuò, wèi tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn pāi guǎnggào. Guǎnggào bōchū yǐhòu, shāngpǐn mài de fēicháng hǎo. Dànshì, guò bù liǎo duōjiǔ, jiù yǒu yàngshì gèng xīn, gèng xīyǐn rén de fúzhuāng chūlái le. Zhè zhǒng "kuàishíshàng" de xiànxiàng, duì mínzhòng de shēnghuó chǎnshēng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
lines.english: Dongxian was formerly a model; he once collaborated with an apparel firm to film commercials for new product promotions. After the commercial aired, products sold extremely well. However, before long, newer and more attractive styles came out. This phenomenon of fast fashion has profoundly impacted everyday life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 所謂「快時尚」，意思是服裝公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服裝設計、生產出來，讓顧客能趕上流行，也能擁有平價的時尚商品。不過，流行的變化速度太快，越來越多新衣服還沒穿就被丟掉，讓人們不能不思考這樣的時尚有沒有意義。
lines.simplified: 所谓「快时尚」，意思是服装公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服装设计、生产出来，让顾客能赶上流行，也能拥有平价的时尚商品。不过，流行的变化速度太快，越来越多新衣服还没穿就被丢掉，让人们不能不思考这样的时尚有没有意义。
lines.pinyin: Suǒwèi "kuàishíshàng", yìsi shì fúzhuāng gōngsī zhǎngwò zuìxīn liúxíng de fāngxiàng, hěn kuài bǎ fúzhuāng shèjì, shēngchǎn chūlái, ràng gùkè néng gǎnshàng liúxíng, yě néng yǒngyǒu píngjià de shíshàng shāngpǐn. Búguò, liúxíng de biànhuà sùdù tài kuài, yuèláiyuè duō xīn yīfú hái méi chuān jiù bèi diūdiào, ràng rénmen bù néng bù sīkǎo zhèyàng de shíshàng yǒu méiyǒu yìyì.
lines.english: The so-called fast fashion means apparel companies capture the latest fashion trends and quickly design and manufacture clothes, allowing customers to catch up with trends while owning affordable fashion items. However, fashion trends change so quickly that more and more new clothes are thrown out before being worn, forcing people to reconsider if such fashion holds real meaning.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 因為工作的需求，東賢的衣櫃裡掛著各式各樣的「快時尚」服裝。平時他不覺得有什麼問題，等到搬家時，才發現衣服這麼多，處理起來真的很麻煩。有的連一次也沒穿過，可是已經不流行了，到底要留下來、送人還是丟掉，讓東賢相當頭痛。他不得不承認，「快時尚」也是有壞處的。
lines.simplified: 因为工作的需求，东贤的衣柜里挂着各式各样的「快时尚」服装。平时他不觉得有什么问题，等到搬家时，才发现衣服这么多，处理起来真的很麻烦。有的连一次也没穿过，可是已经不流行了，到底要留下来、送人还是丢掉，让东贤相当头痛。他不得不承认，「快时尚」也是有坏处的。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de xūqiú, Dōngxián de yīguì lǐ guàzhe gèshì gèyàng de "kuàishíshàng" fúzhuāng. Píngshí tā bù juéde yǒu shénme wèntí, děng dào bānjiā shí, cái fāxiàn yīfú zhème duō, chǔlǐ qǐlái zhēn de hěn máfan. Yǒude lián yí cì yě méi chuān guo, kěshì yǐjīng bù liúxíng le, dàodǐ yào liú xiàlái, sòng rén háishì diūdiào, ràng Dōngxián xiāngdāng tóutòng. Tā bùdébù chéngrèn, "kuàishíshàng" yě shì yǒu huàichù de.
lines.english: Due to job needs, Dongxian's closet was hung with all kinds of fast-fashion garments. Ordinarily he felt no issue, but when moving, he realized there were so many clothes and sorting them out was genuinely troublesome. Some hadn't even been worn once, yet were already out of style; whether to keep, gift, or toss them gave Dongxian a huge headache. He had to admit that fast fashion also brings harms.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 過去，東賢對穿著不太有自信，也很擔心跟不上流行，所以才不斷地追求時尚。現在，他比較冷靜了，他要當衣服的主人，不再為了趕流行亂買衣服。況且把舊衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有個性、很有品味，所以在東賢心中，沒有什麼是非買不可的。畢竟「快時尚」只是一時的流行，長得再帥、再漂亮的人，也應該找出屬於自己最合適的穿著，這樣才是正確的選擇。
lines.simplified: 过去，东贤对穿着不太有自信，也很担心跟不上流行，所以才不断地追求时尚。现在，他比较冷静了，他要当衣服的主人，不再为了赶流行乱买衣服。况且把旧衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有个性、很有品味，所以在东贤心中，没有什么是非买不可的。毕竟「快时尚」只是一时的流行，长得再帅、再漂亮的人，也应该找出属于自己最合适的人穿着，这样才是正确的选择。
lines.pinyin: Guòqù, Dōngxián duì chuānzhuó bú tài yǒu zìxìn, yě hěn dānxīn gēnbushàng liúxíng, suǒyǐ cái búduàn de zhuīqiú shíshàng. Xiànzài, tā bǐjiào lěngjìng le, tā yào dāng yīfú de zhǔrén, bú zài wèile gǎn liúxíng luàn mǎi yīfú. Kuàngqiě bǎ jiù yīfú xiūgǎi yíxià, yě néng shǐ zìjǐ chuān de hěn gèxìng, hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ zài Dōngxián xīnzhōng, méiyǒu shénme shì fēi mǎi bù kě de. Bìjìng "kuàishíshàng" zhǐ shì yìshí de liúxíng, zhǎng de zài shuài, zài piàoliang de rén, yě yīnggāi zhǎochū shǔyú zìjǐ zuì héshì de chuānzhuó, zhèyàng cái shì zhèngquè de xuǎnzé.
lines.english: In the past, Dongxian lacked confidence in dressing and constantly feared falling behind trends, which drove him to chase fashion non-stop. Now he has calmed down; he wants to be the master of clothes and no longer buys thoughtlessly to chase fads. Moreover, modifying old clothes can also allow one to dress with distinction and taste, so in his mind, nothing is an absolute must-buy. After all, fast fashion is merely a temporary fad; no matter how handsome or pretty one is, finding the attire that truly suits oneself is the right choice.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a stronger, supplementary reason to reinforce your decision or conclusion.
grammarPages.explanation: 「況且」當連詞，表示更進一層的語氣，用來補充說明，讓理由更完整。常和「也、還、又」配合使用。
grammarPages.pattern: Primary Reason，況且 + (Subject) + 也/還/又 + Further Reason

text.traditional: 現在他不再為了趕流行亂買衣服。況且把舊衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有個性、很有品味。
text.simplified: 现在他不再为了赶流行乱买衣服。况且把旧衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有个性、很有品味。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài tā bú zài wèile gǎn liúxíng luàn mǎi yīfú. Kuàngqiě bǎ jiù yīfú xiūgǎi yíxià, yě néng shǐ zìjǐ chuān de hěn gèxìng, hěn yǒu pǐnwèi.
text.english: Now he no longer buys recklessly to chase fads. Moreover, modifying old clothes can also let him dress with character and taste.

words.pinyin: xiànzài tā bú zài luàn mǎi yīfú

words.traditional: 況且把舊衣服修改一下
words.simplified: 况且把旧衣服修改一下
words.pinyin: kuàngqiě bǎ jiù yīfú xiūgǎi yíxià

text.traditional: 爸爸要我將來管理他的公司，可是我沒興趣，況且我還有自己的夢想，所以不想去。
text.simplified: 爸爸要我将来管理他的公司，可是我没兴趣，况且我还有自己的梦想，所以不想去。
text.pinyin: Bàba yào wǒ jiānglái guǎnlǐ tā de gōngsī, kěshì wǒ méi xìngqù, kuàngqiě wǒ hái yǒu zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng, suǒyǐ bù xiǎng qù.
text.english: Dad wants me to manage his firm in the future, but I have no interest, and moreover I have my own dream, so I don't want to go.

words.meaning: dad wants me to manage firm

text.traditional: 你是學電影藝術的，況且也寫過劇本、當過演員，可以嘗試一下。
text.simplified: 你是学电影艺术的，况且也写过剧本、当过演员，可以尝试一下。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shì xué diànyǐng yìshù de, kuàngqiě yě xiě guo jùběn, dāng guo yǎnyuán, kěyǐ chángshì yíxià.
text.english: You studied film arts, and moreover you've written scripts and acted; you can give it a try.

words.pinyin: nǐ shì xué diànyǐng yìshù de

items.question: How do you explain turning down an overseas transfer because you are unfamiliar with it and your child is small?
items.answer: 國外我不熟悉，況且孩子還小。
items.wrongTraditional: 國外我不熟悉，但是孩子還小。
items.wrongSimplified: 国外我不熟悉，但是孩子还小。
