items.prompt: Encourage someone with modest education that hard work earns everyone's respect:

result.traditional: 只要肯努力，大家都會看得起你的。
result.simplified: 只要肯努力，大家都会看得起你的。
result.pinyin: Zhǐyào kěn nǔlì, dàjiā dōu huì kàndeqǐ nǐ de.
result.english: As long as you are willing to work hard, everyone will respect you.

repairs.note: Hard work wins respect (看得起你).
The natural counterpart to 看不起 is 看得起.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 看得起你.

items.prompt: Express frustration with incompetent people who look down on hardworking peers:

result.traditional: 他自己沒本事，卻常常看不起人，真受不了。

result.pinyin: Tā zìjǐ méi běnshì, què chángcháng kànbùqǐ rén, zhēn shòubùliǎo.
result.english: He has no skills himself, yet constantly looks down on people; it's intolerable.

repairs.note: Complaining about arrogance uses 看不起人.
To demean and disdain others is 看不起人.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 看不起人.

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · Online Socializing Pros and Cons

dialogue.title: 短文 · 網路交友的優缺點

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 自從無線網路出現的那天起，現代人的生活似乎就離不開網路了。網路科技的進步，不但改變了從前的生活方式，甚至連人與人之間的關係，也產生了極大的變化。住在不同地區的人，可以透過網路互相交流，這一點是我們祖父母那個年代的人很難想像的。
lines.simplified: 自从无线网络出现的那天起，现代人的生活似乎就离不开网络了。网络科技的进步，不但改变了从前的生活方式，甚至连人与人之间的关系，也产生了极大的变化。住在不同地区的人，可以透过网络互相交流，这一点是我们祖父母那个年代的人很难想象的。
lines.pinyin: Zìcóng wúxiàn wǎnglù chūxiàn de nà tiān qǐ, xiàndài rén de shēnghuó sìhū jiù líbùkāi wǎnglù le. Wǎnglù kējì de jìnbù, búdàn gǎibiàn le cóngqián de shēnghuó fāngshì, shènzhì lián rén yǔ rén zhījiān de guānxì, yě chǎnshēng le jídà de biànhuà. Zhù zài bùtóng dìqū de rén, kěyǐ tòuguò wǎnglù hùxiāng jiāoliú, zhè yì diǎn shì wǒmen zǔfùmǔ nà ge niándài de rén hěn nán xiǎngxiàng de.
lines.english: Ever since wireless internet emerged, modern life seems inseparable from the web. Technological advances not only altered former lifestyles, but profoundly transformed relationships between people. Individuals residing in diverse regions can connect online—something hard to fathom for our grandparents' generation.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在網路出現以前，想要做報告，得去圖書館借一堆書；想要認識新朋友，就非和本人面對面接觸不可。但現代社會，只要有網路，就沒有時間和空間的限制，人人都可以隨時隨地傳訊息、查資料、認識世界各地的人。不但擴大了視野、增加了知識，甚至能和網友建立珍貴的友誼。但也因為這樣，越來越多人以網路傳訊息代替當面對話。時間久了，有些人反而失去了在真實生活中與人接觸的能力，這真是不可忽視的缺點。
lines.simplified: 在网络出现以前，想要做报告，得去图书馆借一堆书；想要认识新朋友，就非和本人面对面接触不可。但现代社会，只要有网络，就没有时间和空间的限制，人人都可以随时随地传讯息、查资料、认识世界各地的人。不但扩大了视野、增加了知识，甚至能和网友建立珍贵的友谊。但也因为这样，越来越多人以网络传讯息代替当面对话。时间久了，有些人反而失去了在真实生活中与人接触的能力，这真是不可忽视的缺点。
lines.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù chūxiàn yǐqián, xiǎng yào zuò bàogào, děi qù túshūguǎn jiè yì duī shū; xiǎng yào rènshì xīn péngyǒu, jiù fēi hé běnrén miànduìmiàn jiēchù bùkě. Dàn xiàndài shèhuì, zhǐyào yǒu wǎnglù, jiù méiyǒu shíjiān hé kōngjiān de xiànzhì, rénrén dōu kěyǐ suíshí suídì chuán xùnxí, chá zīliào, rènshì shìjiè gèdì de rén. Búdàn kuòdà le shìyě, zēngjiā le zhīshì, shènzhì néng hé wǎngyǒu jiànlì zhēnguì de yǒuyì. Dàn yě yīnwèi zhèyàng, yuèláiyuè duō rén yǐ wǎnglù chuán xùnxí dàitì dāngmiàn duìhuà. Shíjiān jiǔ le, yǒuxiē rén fǎn'ér shīqù le zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng yǔ rén jiēchù de nénglì, zhè zhēn shì bù kě hūshì de quēdiǎn.
lines.english: Before the internet, preparing reports meant borrowing piles of library books; meeting new people required face-to-face encounters. Today, with connectivity free from temporal and geographic boundaries, anyone can message, look up info, and meet people worldwide anytime, expanding horizons, building knowledge, and forging valuable friendships. Yet precisely because of this, more people substitute texting for in-person conversations. Over time, some lose real-world interpersonal competence—a significant drawback.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 再說，網路雖然為現代人帶來了不少好處，但也有壞處。比如有些人在網路上說的話不一定是真的。某人已經五十歲了，在網路上卻說自己才二十歲，甚至拿別人的照片當作自己的大頭照。更嚴重的是，有些騙子利用別人的同情心騙錢，那些騙子不僅可惡，還對不起社會。
lines.simplified: 再说，网络虽然为现代人带来了不少好处，但也有坏处。比如有些人在网络上说的话不一定是真的。某人已经五十岁了，在网络上却说自己才二十岁，甚至拿别人的照片当作自己的大头照。更严重的是，有些骗子利用别人的同情心骗钱，那些骗子不仅可恶，还对不起社会。
lines.pinyin: Zàishuō, wǎnglù suīrán wèi xiàndài rén dàilái le bùshǎo hǎochù, dàn yě yǒu huàichù. Bǐrú yǒuxiē rén zài wǎnglù shàng shuō de huà bù yídìng shì zhēn de. Mǒu rén yǐjīng wǔshí suì le, zài wǎnglù shàng què shuō zìjǐ cái èrshí suì, shènzhì ná biérén de zhàopiàn dāngzuò zìjǐ de dàtóuzhào. Gèng yánzhòng de shì, yǒuxiē piànzi lìyòng biérén de tóngqíngxīn piàn qián, nàxiē piànzi bùjǐn kěwù, hái duìbùqǐ shèhuì.
lines.english: Furthermore, while the internet delivers immense convenience, it also brings harms. Online claims may not be truthful: someone already fifty may claim to be twenty, even stealing others' photos for their avatar. More gravely, fraudsters exploit empathy to extort money—scammers who are not only loathsome but fail society.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友，或是能不能找到合適的對象，就得看個人的智慧了。畢竟真實生活中的朋友，無論如何都比虛擬世界的網友重要，沒有人可以取代。
lines.simplified: 网络只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网络交友，或是能不能找到合适的对象，就得看个人的智慧了。毕竟真实生活中的朋友，无论如何都比虚拟世界的网友重要，没有人可以取代。
lines.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, huòshì néng bù néng zhǎodào héshì de duìxiàng, jiù děi kàn gèrén de zhìhuì le. Bìjìng zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng de péngyǒu, wúlùn rúhé dōu bǐ xūnǐ shìjiè de wǎngyǒu zhòngyào, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
lines.english: The internet merely offers a more convenient social conduit; as for whether to seek online friendships or successfully find suitable matches, that depends on personal discernment. After all, real-life companions remain incomparably more vital than virtual contacts and cannot be replaced.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight an unexpected, contrary result or reality using the adverb 卻 ('yet / however').

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Live Up to / Let Down with 對得起 / 對不起
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express living up to expectations (對得起) or feeling guilty for letting someone down (對不起).
grammarPages.explanation: 「對得起」表示沒做不好或不應該的事，沒讓對方失望、生氣、丟臉。「對不起」的意思跟「對得起」相反。「對得起/對不起」後面可接對象，如：對得起父母、對得起老闆、對不起良心、對不起社會。

items.prompt: Friend works overtime every night. Warn that ruining health fails one's own well-being:

segments.traditional: 要是把身體弄壞了，你怎麼

result.traditional: 要是把身體弄壞了，你怎麼對得起自己呢？
result.simplified: 要是把身体弄坏了，你怎么对得起自己呢？
result.pinyin: Yàoshì bǎ shēntǐ nònghuài le, nǐ zěnme duìdeqǐ zìjǐ ne?
result.english: If you ruin your health, how will you face yourself in good conscience?

repairs.note: Rhetorical rebuke: 怎麼對得起自己呢？
The obligation to care for oneself uses 對得起自己.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 對得起自.

items.prompt: A friend was hit by a car while buying lunch for you. Apologize with profound guilt:

segments.traditional: 都是因為幫我買飯，我真

result.traditional: 都是因為幫我買飯，我真對不起你！
result.simplified: 都是因为帮我买饭，我真对不起你！
result.pinyin: Dōu shì yīnwèi bāng wǒ mǎi fàn, wǒ zhēn duìbùqǐ nǐ!
result.english: It was all because of buying lunch for me; I have truly wronged you!

repairs.note: When you caused someone trouble, express guilt with 對不起你.
Apologizing over an unfortunate mishap uses 對不起.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 對不起你.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: As for / Turning to with 至於
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Pivot to an associated point, unresolved question, or secondary topic with 至於 ('as for...').
grammarPages.explanation: 「至於」當句子之間的轉折語，引出另一個與原來主題相關的話題或觀點。
grammarPages.pattern: Primary Statement，至於 + Secondary Related Topic + Predicate

text.traditional: 網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友，就得看個人的智慧了。
text.simplified: 网络只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网络交友，就得看个人的智慧了。
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, jiù děi kàn gèrén de zhìhuì le.
text.english: The web merely offers convenient social channels; as for whether to use online dating, that depends on personal wisdom.

words.meaning: as for whether to make friends

text.traditional: 那對情侶有結婚的打算，至於什麼時候舉行婚禮，還要問家長的意見。
text.simplified: 那对情侣有结婚的打算，至于什么时候举行婚礼，还要问家长的意见。
text.pinyin: Nà duì qínglǚ yǒu jiéhūn de dǎsuàn, zhìyú shénme shíhou jǔxíng hūnlǐ, hái yào wèn jiāzhǎng de yìjiàn.
text.english: That couple intends to wed; as to when the ceremony will take place, they still need to consult parents.

text.traditional: 我只知道教育制度的改善計畫是夏教授帶領的，至於詳細內容就得問他本人了。
text.simplified: 我只知道教育制度的改善计划是夏教授带领的，至于详细内容就得问他本人了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ zhīdào jiàoyù zhìdù de gǎishàn jìhuà shì Xià jiàoshòu dàilǐng de, zhìyú xiángxì nèiróng jiù děi wèn tā běnrén le.
text.english: I only know Professor Xia leads the education reform initiative; as for details, you will have to ask him directly.

items.question: How do you express interest in translation while leaving career decisions open?
items.answer: 我對翻譯有興趣，至於當不當正職，還要再考慮。
items.wrongTraditional: 我對翻譯有興趣，關於當不當正職，還要再考慮。
items.wrongSimplified: 我对翻译有兴趣，关于当不当正职，还要再考虑。

right.traditional: 我對翻譯有興趣，至於當不當正職，還要再考慮。
right.simplified: 我对翻译有兴趣，至于当不当正职，还要再考虑。
right.pinyin: Wǒ duì fānyì yǒu xìngqù, zhìyú dāng bù dāng zhèngzhí, hái yào zài kǎolǜ.
right.english: I'm interested in translation; as for doing it full-time, I still need to consider.

items.question: How do you pivot to unresolved breakup questions after sibling quarreled with partner?
items.answer: 他們現在不講話，至於會不會分手，還不知道。
items.wrongTraditional: 他們現在不講話，而且會不會分手，還不知道。
items.wrongSimplified: 他们现在不讲话，而且会不会分手，还不知道。

right.traditional: 他們現在不講話，至於會不會分手，還不知道。
right.simplified: 他们现在不讲话，至于会不会分手，还不知道。
right.pinyin: Tāmen xiànzài bù jiǎnghuà, zhìyú huì bú huì fēnshǒu, hái bù zhīdào.
right.english: They aren't on speaking terms now; as for whether they'll break up, it's still unknown.

questions.prompt: State your travel arrangement responsibilities while deferring hotel bookings:
questions.correctFeedback: 至於 introduces an associated secondary topic or deferred detail.
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: Statement, + 至於 + Topic.

items.prompt: A suggests working in translation. State you have interest, but full-time career needs thought:

result.traditional: 我對翻譯有興趣，至於當不當正職，還要再考慮。
result.simplified: 我对翻译有兴趣，至于当不当正职，还要再考虑。
result.pinyin: Wǒ duì fānyì yǒu xìngqù, zhìyú dāng bù dāng zhèngzhí, hái yào zài kǎolǜ.
result.english: I have interest in translation; as to whether to make it a career, I still need to consider.

repairs.note: Pivoting to an open associated question uses 至於.
Use 至於 as a conversational turning point for secondary matters.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 至於當不.

items.prompt: A asks about sister's intense fight with boyfriend. State they aren't speaking, breakup undecided:

result.traditional: 到現在還不講話，至於會不會分手，目前還不知道。
result.simplified: 到现在还不讲话，至于会不会分手，目前还不知道。
result.pinyin: Dào xiànzài hái bù jiǎnghuà, zhìyú huì bú huì fēnshǒu, mùqián hái bù zhīdào.
result.english: They still aren't speaking; as for whether they'll break up, it's still unknown.

repairs.note: Pivot to an uncertain future development using 至於.
Use 至於 to introduce the secondary unresolved question.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 至於會不.

items.prompt: A asks if you'll quit work permanently for family after baby. State future is undecided:

result.traditional: 目前先照顧孩子，至於以後的事，等以後再說吧。
result.simplified: 目前先照顾孩子，至于以后的事，等以后再说吧。
result.pinyin: Mùqián xiān zhàogù háizi, zhìyú yǐhòu de shì, děng yǐhòu zàishuō ba.
result.english: For now I'll look after the child; as for later matters, we'll talk later.

repairs.note: Deferring future topics uses 至於 (至於以後的事).
Use 至於 to transition to the uncommitted topic.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 至於以後.

items.prompt: Foreign friend asks for Taiwan tour recommendations. Suggest Taipei, deferring other regions:

result.traditional: 臺北我比較熟，至於其他縣市，你可以問問小林。
result.simplified: 台北我比较熟，至于其他县市，你可以问问小林。
result.pinyin: Táiběi wǒ bǐjiào shú, zhìyú qítā xiànshì, nǐ kěyǐ wènwen Xiǎo Lín.
result.english: I'm relatively familiar with Taipei; as for other counties, you can consult Xiao Lin.

repairs.note: Pivoting to other regions uses 至於 (至於其他……).
Use 至於 to demarcate the topic shift.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 至於其他.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Do You Have Interview Experience?

dialogue.title: 你有面試的經驗嗎？

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 您好，我是林家豪。貴公司上星期通知我今天十點來面試。
lines.simplified: 您好，我是林家豪。贵公司上星期通知我今天十点来面试。
lines.pinyin: Nínhǎo, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Guì gōngsī shàngxīngqī tōngzhī wǒ jīntiān shí diǎn lái miànshì.
lines.english: Hello, I am Lin Jiahao. Your company informed me last week to come for an interview at ten today.

lines.speaker: 職員
lines.traditional: 林先生，歡迎您來本公司參加面試。請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
lines.simplified: 林先生，欢迎您来本公司参加面试。请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
lines.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng, huānyíng nín lái běn gōngsī cānjiā miànshì. Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
lines.english: Mr. Lin, welcome to our company for the interview. Please take a seat, I will inform the manager right away.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 你好。我姓王，負責今天的面試。
lines.simplified: 你好。我姓王，负责今天的面试。
lines.pinyin: Nǐhǎo. Wǒ xìng Wáng, fùzé jīntiān de miànshì.
lines.english: Hello. My surname is Wang, and I am in charge of today's interview.

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 您好，王經理，我是林家豪。這是我的工作經驗相關資料，請您參考。
lines.simplified: 您好，王经理，我是林家豪。这是我的工作经验相关资料，请您参考。
lines.pinyin: Nínhǎo, Wáng jīnglǐ, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Zhè shì wǒ de gōngzuò jīngyàn xiāngguān zīliào, qǐng nín cānkǎo.
lines.english: Hello, Manager Wang, I am Lin Jiahao. This is the information related to my work experience for your reference.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
lines.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
lines.english: We are looking for sales personnel this time. Do you have experience in this field?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 念大學時，我在電腦公司打過工。向客人介紹商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差異，最重要的是想辦法把商品賣出去。
lines.simplified: 念大学时，我在电脑公司打过工。向客人介绍商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差异，最重要的是想办法把商品卖出去。
lines.pinyin: Niàn dàxué shí, wǒ zài diànnǎo gōngsī dǎguo gōng. Xiàng kèrén jièshào shāngpǐn gōngnéng, shǐyòng fāngfǎ, hé qítā páizi de chāyì, zuì zhòngyào de shì xiǎng bànfǎ bǎ shāngpǐn mài chūqù.
lines.english: In university, I worked part-time at a computer company, introducing product features, instructions, and differences from other brands to customers. The most important thing was finding ways to sell products.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 不過推銷時，多多少少都會碰到喜歡隨便批評，甚至對你亂發脾氣的客人，你會怎麼處理呢？
lines.simplified: 不过推销时，多多少少都会碰到喜欢随便批评，甚至对你乱发脾气的客人，你会怎么处理呢？
lines.pinyin: Búguò tuīxiāo shí, duōduōshǎoshǎo dōu huì pèngdào xǐhuan suíbiàn pīpíng, shènzhì duì nǐ luàn fā píqì de kèrén, nǐ huì zěnme chǔlǐ ne?
lines.english: However, when selling, you will more or less encounter customers who criticize casually or even lose their tempers at you. How would you handle that?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 我會先了解問題是什麼，然後耐心地跟他說明，想辦法讓他理解。我想只要態度親切、謙虛，客人就會接受的。萬一他還是不滿意，我就說笑話逗他開心，或是送他小禮物什麼的。
lines.simplified: 我会先了解问题是什么，然后耐心地跟他说明，想办法让他理解。我想只要态度亲切、谦虚，客人就会接受的。万一他还是不满意，我就说笑话逗他开心，或是送他小礼物什么的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiān liǎojiě wèntí shì shénme, ránhòu nàixīn de gēn tā shuōmíng, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng tā lǐjiě. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào tàidù qīnqiè, qiānxū, kèrén jiù huì jiēshòu de. Wànyī tā háishì bù mǎnyì, wǒ jiù shuō xiàohuà dòu tā kāixīn, huòshì sòng tā xiǎo lǐwù shénme de.
lines.english: I would first find out what the problem is, then patiently explain and help them understand. As long as one is warm and humble, customers will accept it. If they are still dissatisfied, I tease them with jokes to cheer them up, or give a small gift.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 你的推銷觀念很正確。透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。在職場上，你碰過什麼大問題嗎？
lines.simplified: 你的推销观念很正确。透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。在职场上，你碰过什么大问题吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de tuīxiāo guānniàn hěn zhèngquè. Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan. Zài zhíchǎng shàng, nǐ pèngguo shénme dà wèntí ma?
lines.english: Your sales philosophy is sound. Through good communication, unnecessary troubles can often be resolved. In the workplace, have you encountered any major problems?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 沒有。不過有一次，公司舉辦電腦遊戲比賽，經理叫我們早上七點先去布置會場，因為鬧鐘壞了，我睡到八點才醒來。等我趕到時，小組的同事早就把任務完成了。雖然大家沒怪我，但我卻不能原諒自己，從那次之後，我就非常注意時間，絕對不再遲到了。
lines.simplified: 没有。不过有一次，公司举办电脑游戏比赛，经理叫我们早上七点先去布置会场，因为闹钟坏了，我睡到八点才醒来。等我赶到时，小组的同事早就把任务完成了。虽然大家没怪我，但我却不能原谅自己，从那次之后，我就非常注意时间，绝对不再迟到了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Búguò yǒu yí cì, gōngsī jǔbàn diànnǎo yóuxì bǐsài, jīnglǐ jiào wǒmen zǎoshang qī diǎn xiān qù bùzhì huìchǎng, yīnwèi nàozhōng huài le, wǒ shuì dào bā diǎn cái xǐnglái. Děng wǒ gǎndào shí, xiǎozǔ de tóngshì zǎojiù bǎ rènwù wánchéng le. Suīrán dàjiā méi guài wǒ, dàn wǒ què bù néng yuánliàng zìjǐ, cóng nà cì zhīhòu, wǒ jiù fēicháng zhùyì shíjiān, juéduì bú zài chídào le.
lines.english: No. But once, the company held a computer gaming contest, and the manager asked us to set up at seven in the morning. My alarm broke and I slept until eight. By the time I arrived, my teammates had already finished. Though no one blamed me, I couldn't forgive myself, and since then I've been extremely punctual and never late.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 其實，不論在哪裡工作，準時是最基本的要求。對了，假如主管忙不過來，你願意配合加班嗎？
lines.simplified: 其实，不论在哪里工作，准时是最基本的要求。对了，假如主管忙不过来，你愿意配合加班吗？
lines.pinyin: Qíshí, búlùn zài nǎlǐ gōngzuò, zhǔnshí shì zuì jīběn de yāoqiú. Duì le, jiǎrú zhǔguǎn mángbuguòlái, nǐ yuànyì pèihé jiābān ma?
lines.english: In fact, no matter where one works, punctuality is the most fundamental requirement. By the way, if the supervisor is too busy to manage, are you willing to cooperate with overtime?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 沒問題。平日或假日，我都能配合。
lines.simplified: 没问题。平日或假日，我都能配合。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Píngrì huò jiàrì, wǒ dōu néng pèihé.
lines.english: No problem. Weekdays or holidays, I can accommodate.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 除了準時，請你再說說自己其他的優點。
lines.simplified: 除了准时，请你再说对自己其他的优点。
lines.pinyin: Chúle zhǔnshí, qǐng nǐ zài shuōshuō zìjǐ qítā de yōudiǎn.
lines.english: Besides punctuality, please tell me about your other strengths.

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 我個性開朗、說話幽默、做事細心、溝通能力強，是個容易相處的人。
lines.simplified: 我个性开朗、说话幽默、做事细心、沟通能力强，是个容易相处的人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gèxìng kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, zuòshì xìxīn, gōutōng nénglì qiáng, shì ge róngyì xiāngchǔ de rén.
lines.english: I have an outgoing personality, a humorous way of speaking, pay attention to detail, communicate strongly, and am easy to get along with.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 聽起來你挺優秀的。對這份工作你還有什麼要了解的？
lines.simplified: 听起来你挺优秀的。对这份工作你还有什么要了解的？
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái nǐ tǐng yōuxiù de. Duì zhè fèn gōngzuò nǐ hái yǒu shénme yào liǎojiě de?
lines.english: You sound quite outstanding. Is there anything else you would like to know about this job?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 請問薪水怎麼算？有哪些福利？
lines.simplified: 请问薪水怎么算？有哪些福利？
lines.pinyin: Qǐngwèn xīnshuǐ zěnme suàn? Yǒu nǎxiē fúlì?
lines.english: May I ask how salary is calculated? What benefits are provided?

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
lines.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
lines.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
lines.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will come explain them to you in detail.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 這就 right before a verb to express that you are carrying out an action right at this very moment.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 這就 + Verb / VP

columns.meaning: go to door to welcome him

text.traditional: 林先生，歡迎您來本公司參加面試。請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
text.simplified: 林先生，欢迎您来本公司参加面试。请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
text.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng, huānyíng nín lái běn gōngsī cānjiā miànshì. Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
text.english: Mr. Lin, welcome to our company for the interview. Please have a seat; I will inform the manager right away.

words.meaning: I will inform the manager right away

text.traditional: 服務生，我點的是熱紅茶，不是冰咖啡。不好意思，我這就幫您換一杯。
text.simplified: 服务生，我点的是热红茶，不是冰咖啡。不好意思，我这就帮您换一杯。
text.pinyin: Fúwùshēng, wǒ diǎn de shì rè hóngchá, bú shì bīng kāfēi. Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ zhè jiù bāng nín huàn yì bēi.
text.english: Waiter, I ordered hot black tea, not iced coffee. Sorry about that, I'll change it for you right away.

words.pinyin: wǒ zhè jiù bāng nín huàn yì bēi
words.meaning: I will replace a cup for you right away

text.traditional: 經理，孔老闆快到公司了。好，我這就到門口去歡迎他。
text.simplified: 经理，孔老板快到公司了。好，我这就到门口去欢迎他。
text.pinyin: Jīnglǐ, Kǒng lǎobǎn kuài dào gōngsī le. Hǎo, wǒ zhè jiù dào ménkǒu qù huānyíng tā.
text.english: Manager, Boss Kong is about to arrive at the company. Okay, I will head to the entrance to welcome him right away.

words.traditional: 我這就到門口去歡迎他
words.simplified: 我这就到门口去欢迎他
words.pinyin: wǒ zhè jiù dào ménkǒu qù huānyíng tā
words.meaning: I will head to the doorway to welcome him right away

items.question: When should you use 這就 instead of a generic time adverb like 馬上?
items.answer: 這就 specifically indicates an immediate response or action undertaken on the spot by the speaker, right at this very second.
items.wrongTraditional: 我明天這就通知經理。
items.wrongSimplified: 我明天这就通知经理。

right.traditional: 請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
right.simplified: 请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
right.pinyin: Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
right.english: Please sit down, I will notify the manager right away.

items.question: Can 這就 be replaced by a simple 就 in immediate responsive declarations?
items.answer: 雖然「就」也能表示馬上，但「這就」強化了「現在這一刻立即採取行動」的現場口語語氣。
items.wrongTraditional: 孔老闆到了，我快快就去門口。
items.wrongSimplified: 孔老板到了，我快快就去门口。

right.traditional: 好，我這就到門口去歡迎他。
right.simplified: 好，我这就到门口去欢迎他。
right.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhè jiù dào ménkǒu qù huānyíng tā.
right.english: Okay, I will head right to the entrance to welcome him.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: A: 請問關老師在嗎？我的孩子想當面向他說聲謝謝。 B: 他在，我
去叫他。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「這就＋動詞」表示說話者現在馬上採取行動。
questions.repairFeedback: 請確認語境：對方在現場詢問，回答者表示「現在立刻去叫他」，應使用「這就」。

grammarPages.explanation: 「這」是「現在」的意思，「就」表示馬上，「這就」的後面接動詞或動詞短語，用來表示現在馬上做某事。

items.prompt: Parent asks if Teacher Guan is in to thank him. Reply that you will fetch him right now:

result.traditional: 他在辦公室，我這就去叫他出來。
result.simplified: 他在办公室，我这就去叫他出来。
result.pinyin: Tā zài bàngōngshì, wǒ zhè jiù qù jiào tā chūlái.
result.english: He is in the office; I will go call him right now.

repairs.note: Immediate actions use 這就, not 難道.
Use 這就 to express carrying out an immediate action right away.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這就去叫.

items.prompt: Child feels feverish and ill. Mom says to bear with it, she will take him to the doctor immediately:

result.traditional: 你忍耐一下，媽媽這就帶你去看醫生。
result.simplified: 你忍耐一下，妈妈这就带你去看医生。
result.pinyin: Nǐ rěnnài yíxià, māma zhè jiù dài nǐ qù kàn yīshēng.
result.english: Bear with it a moment; Mom will take you to see the doctor right now.

repairs.note: Use 這就 to indicate action taken on the spot.
Immediate responsive actions take 這就.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這就帶你.

items.prompt: Leather shoes are 35% off today. Respond eagerly that you're going to buy them right now:

result.traditional: 太好了，那我這就去買一雙。
result.simplified: 太好了，那我这就去买一双。
result.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, nà wǒ zhè jiù qù mǎi yì shuāng.
result.english: Great, then I'll head over to buy a pair right away.

repairs.note: Use 這就 to express prompt action on the spot.
這就 indicates doing something immediately right now.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這就去買.

items.prompt: Customer received wrong drink. Apologize and say you will replace it immediately:

result.traditional: 不好意思，我這就幫您換一杯熱紅茶。
result.simplified: 不好意思，我这就帮您换一杯热红茶。
result.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ zhè jiù bāng nín huàn yì bēi rè hóngchá.
result.english: Sorry about that, I will exchange a cup of hot black tea for you right away.

repairs.note: Carrying out a correction immediately takes 這就.
Use 這就 for immediate service actions on the spot.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這就幫您.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Specifying Scope or Domain: 在……方面
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Frame a specific domain or angle of discussion using 在……方面.
grammarPages.pattern: 在 + Domain / Activity + 方面, + Predicate

text.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
text.english: We are looking for sales staff this time. Do you have experience in this field?

words.pinyin: nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma
words.meaning: do you have experience in this area?

text.traditional: 在穿著方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有個人的風格。
text.simplified: 在穿着方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有个人的风格。
text.pinyin: Zài chuānzhuó fāngmiàn, Bái xiǎojiě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, shēnshang chuān de huò shǒushang dài de yě dōu yǒu gèrén de fēnggé.
text.english: In terms of attire, Miss Bai has good taste; what she wears on her body or wrist all reflects individual style.

text.traditional: 小藍從小在網球方面就表現得非常好，長大之後一定能代表國家參加比賽。
text.simplified: 小蓝从小在网球方面就表现得非常好，长大之后一定能代表国家参加比赛。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài wǎngqiú fāngmiàn jiù biǎoxiàn de fēicháng hǎo, zhǎngdà zhīhòu yídìng néng dàibiǎo guójiā cānjiā bǐsài.
text.english: Xiao Lan has performed remarkably well in tennis since childhood; when he grows up, he will surely represent the country in tournaments.

items.question: How is 在……方面 different from 對……來說?
items.answer: 「在……方面」界定討論的領域、專業或範圍；「對……來說」則界定評估的角度或主體視角。
items.wrongTraditional: 對穿著方面，白小姐很有品味。
items.wrongSimplified: 对穿着方面，白小姐很有品味。

right.traditional: 在穿著方面，白小姐很有品味。
right.simplified: 在穿着方面，白小姐很有品味。
right.pinyin: Zài chuānzhuó fāngmiàn, Bái xiǎojiě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi.
right.english: In terms of attire, Miss Bai has great taste.

items.question: Can 方面 be omitted when defining a domain?
items.answer: 「在」與「方面」搭配成框架標記範疇，若缺少「方面」，句子往往失去界定領域的完整結構。
items.wrongTraditional: 你在這有經驗嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 你在这有经验吗？

right.traditional: 你在這方面有經驗嗎？
right.simplified: 你在这方面有经验吗？
right.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
right.english: Do you have experience in this field?

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我從來沒辦過戶外演唱會，在辦活動
，老李的經驗很豐富，我恐怕幫不了你。

questions.correctFeedback: 正確！「在＋範圍＋方面」用來說明在某個領域或情形下的狀況。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意框架搭配：「在辦活動……」接「方面」，用以界定特定範疇。

grammarPages.explanation: 用來說明在某個範圍或某個情況下的情形。「在」和「方面」中間是該範圍或情況，後面的句子表示產生什麼樣的情形或進一步的說明。

items.prompt: A asks for concert advice. State that Lao Li has rich experience in organizing events:

result.traditional: 在辦活動方面，老李的經驗很豐富。
result.simplified: 在办活动方面，老李的经验很丰富。
result.pinyin: Zài bàn huódòng fāngmiàn, Lǎo Lǐ de jīngyàn hěn fēngfù.
result.english: In terms of organizing events, Lao Li's experience is very extensive.

repairs.note: Frame the domain using 在……方面.
Defining an activity scope takes 在……方面.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 方面.

items.prompt: Dr. Chen is also an artist. Affirm that he has always been outstanding in art:

result.traditional: 是啊，他在藝術方面也一向很優秀。
result.simplified: 是啊，他在艺术方面也一向很优秀。
result.pinyin: Shì a, tā zài yìshù fāngmiàn yě yíxiàng hěn yōuxiù.
result.english: Yes, he has always been outstanding in the realm of art as well.

repairs.note: Use 藝術方面 with 在 to specify the domain.
Specifying a talent domain uses 在……方面.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 方面.

items.prompt: Friend needs decorating help. Recommend Xiao Lin for his talent in interior design:

result.traditional: 在設計方面，小林很有才華，你可以找他。
result.simplified: 在设计方面，小林很有才华，你可以找他。
result.pinyin: Zài shèjì fāngmiàn, Xiǎo Lín hěn yǒu cáihuá, nǐ kěyǐ zhǎo tā.
result.english: In terms of design, Xiao Lin is very talented; you can consult him.

repairs.note: Marking field of skill requires 在……方面.
The frame 在 + field + 方面 marks domain.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 方面.

items.prompt: Interviewer asks about experience. Answer that your experience is rich in sales:

result.traditional: 在推銷方面，我的經驗相當豐富。
result.simplified: 在推销方面，我的经验相当丰富。
result.pinyin: Zài tuīxiāo fāngmiàn, wǒ de jīngyàn xiāngdāng fēngfù.
result.english: In terms of sales promotion, my experience is quite rich.

repairs.note: Frame the area of experience with 在……方面.
Use 方面 with 在 to specify the professional scope.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 方面.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: General Tendencies and Regularities: 往往
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State recurring general patterns and empirical regularities using 往往.
grammarPages.pattern: Condition, + Subject + 往往 + Regularity

columns.pinyin: néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan

columns.meaning: whether or not to go to cram school

columns.pinyin: bú shì háizi nénggòu juédìng de
columns.meaning: is not for kids to decide

text.traditional: 你的推銷觀念很正確。透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。
text.simplified: 你的推销观念很正确。透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。
text.pinyin: Nǐ de tuīxiāo guānniàn hěn zhèngquè. Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan.
text.english: Your sales concept is very correct. Through good communication, unnecessary troubles can often be resolved.

text.traditional: 許多家長都會逼孩子念書，要不要去補習往往不是孩子能夠決定的。
text.simplified: 许多家长都会逼孩子念书，要不要去补习往往不是孩子能够决定的。
text.pinyin: Xǔduō jiāzhǎng dōu huì bī háizi niànshū, yào bú yào qù bǔxí wǎngwǎng bú shì háizi nénggòu juédìng de.
text.english: Many parents force their children to study; whether to attend cram school is often not up to the children themselves.

text.traditional: 一般來說，夢想與真實生活往往有一段距離，不可能每次都夢想成真。
text.simplified: 一般来说，梦想与真实生活往往有一段距离，不可能每次都梦想成真。
text.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, mèngxiǎng yǔ zhēnshí shēnghuó wǎngwǎng yǒu yí duàn jùlí, bù kěnéng měi cì dōu mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
text.english: Generally speaking, there is often a gap between dreams and real life; one cannot realize every single dream.

words.traditional: 不可能每次都夢想成真
words.simplified: 不可能每次都梦想成真
words.pinyin: bù kěnéng měi cì dōu mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn
words.meaning: impossible to realize dreams every time

items.question: How does 往往 differ from 常常?
items.answer: 「往往」表示在一定條件下經常出現的規律或客觀事實，不能用於個人主觀意願或未發生的事，且不能被否定（不能說「不往往」）；「常常」純粹表示頻率高，可用於個人習慣與意願。
items.wrongTraditional: 我希望下個月往往去慢跑。
items.wrongSimplified: 我希望下个月往往去慢跑。

right.traditional: 只要天氣好，他往往起床後就去慢跑。
right.simplified: 只要天气好，他往往起床后就去慢跑。
right.pinyin: Zhǐyào tiānqì hǎo, tā wǎngwǎng qǐchuáng hòu jiù qù mànpǎo.
right.english: As long as the weather is fine, he tends to go jogging after getting up.

items.question: Can 往往 appear with negative markers like 不 before it?
items.answer: 不行。「往往」前面不能加否定詞，否定詞必須放在「往往」之後（例如：往往不是、往往沒有）。
items.wrongTraditional: 他不往往週末去打球。
items.wrongSimplified: 他不往往周末去打球。

right.traditional: 要不要補習往往不是孩子能決定的。
right.simplified: 要不要补习往往不是孩子能决定的。
right.pinyin: Yào bú yào bǔxí wǎngwǎng bú shì háizi néng juédìng de.
right.english: Whether to attend cram school is often not something children can decide.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 照我過去的習慣，為了讓資料正確，我
會請其他人再檢查一次。

questions.correctFeedback: 沒錯！「往往」表示在特定條件或規律下經常出現的常態情況。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意句意：根據過去的習慣和規律，常態性地請人檢查，應用「往往」。

grammarPages.explanation: 「往往」表示在一定的條件下，從過去到現在經常發生的經驗或情況，不能用在未發生的事情，而且有一定的規律。用於一般的看法或事實，不能用在個人主觀的意願。

items.prompt: Colleague asks why you recheck documents. State that past habit is to confirm content again:

result.traditional: 照過去的習慣，我往往會再確認一次內容。
result.simplified: 照过去的习惯，我往往会再确认一次内容。
result.pinyin: Zhào guòqù de xíguàn, wǒ wǎngwǎng huì zài quèrèn yí cì nèiróng.
result.english: According to past habit, I tend to verify the content once more.

repairs.note: Regular patterns based on habits use 往往.
Use 往往 to indicate habitual tendencies.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 往往會再.

items.prompt: A asks about New Year habits. Note that families regularly pay respects to ancestors on Eve:

result.traditional: 除夕當天全家人往往得拜祖先，還要吃年夜飯。
result.simplified: 除夕当天全家人往往得拜祖先，还要吃年夜饭。
result.pinyin: Chúxì dāngtiān quánjiārén wǎngwǎng děi bài zǔxiān, hái yào chī niányèfàn.
result.english: On New Year's Eve, the entire family regularly has to pay respects to ancestors, and eat reunion dinner.

repairs.note: Use 往往 to describe established annual regularities.
Regular customs under set conditions take 往往.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 往往得拜.

items.prompt: State that nervous and excited feelings are often common manifestations in interviews:

segments.traditional: 是面試時經常有的表現。

result.traditional: 這樣的心情，往往是面試時經常有的表現。
result.simplified: 这样的心情，往往是面试时经常有的表现。
result.pinyin: Zhèyàng de xīnqíng, wǎngwǎng shì miànshì shí jīngcháng yǒu de biǎoxiàn.
result.english: Such feelings are often the manifestations common during interviews.

repairs.note: Common natural tendencies take 往往.
Use 往往 to describe empirical regularities.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 往往.

items.prompt: Manager praises communication concept. Reiterate that good dialogue resolves trouble:

result.traditional: 透過良好溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。
result.simplified: 透过良好沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。
result.pinyin: Tòuguò liánghǎo gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan.
result.english: Through good communication, unnecessary troubles can often be resolved.

repairs.note: General truths and outcomes take 往往.
Use 往往 to indicate typical outcomes under sound conditions.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 往往.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Introduce the topic or matter under discussion at the sentence opening with 有關.
grammarPages.pattern: 有關 + Topic, + Predicate / Explanation

columns.pinyin: huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái shuōmíng
hái yào jīngguò xiángxì de diàochá

text.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
text.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
text.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will come explain them to you in detail.

text.traditional: 有關那個明星吸毒的新聞，還要經過詳細地調查，才能確定是真是假。
text.simplified: 有关那个明星吸毒的新闻，还要经过详细地调查，才能确定是真是假。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān nà ge míngxīng xīdú de xīnwén, hái yào jīngguò xiángxì de diàochá, cái néng quèdìng shì zhēn shì jiǎ.
text.english: Regarding the news about that celebrity taking drugs, a thorough investigation is still needed to confirm truth or falsehood.

words.traditional: 有關那個明星吸毒的新聞
words.simplified: 有关那个明星吸毒的新闻
words.pinyin: yǒuguān nà ge míngxīng xīdú de xīnwén

text.traditional: 有關法律方面的問題，你最好請教專業律師，不要隨便相信網路上的說法。
text.simplified: 有关法律方面的问题，你最好请教专业律师，不要随便相信网络上的说法。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān fǎlǜ fāngmiàn de wèntí, nǐ zuìhǎo qǐngjiào zhuānyè lǜshī, bú yào suíbiàn xiāngxìn wǎnglù shàng de shuōfǎ.
text.english: Regarding legal questions, you had better consult a professional lawyer rather than blindly trusting claims on the internet.

items.question: How is 有關 used compared with 對於?
items.answer: 「有關」置於句首引出討論的題材或對象，指「涉及……」；「對於」則引出對象以表達對該對象的態度或看法。
items.wrongTraditional: 在於這方面的問題，會有專人說明。
items.wrongSimplified: 在于这方面的问题，会有专人说明。

right.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員說明。
right.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员说明。
right.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán shuōmíng.
right.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will explain.

items.question: Can 有關 directly modify a noun or introduce a prepositional topic?
items.answer: 「有關」常置於句首作介詞引導話題（有關……），亦可作為修飾語（跟……有關的資料）。
items.wrongTraditional: 朝向這方面的問題，請看網站。
items.wrongSimplified: 朝向这方面的问题，请看网站。

right.traditional: 有關這類的活動，你看旅遊中心網站就知道了。
right.simplified: 有关这类的活动，你看旅游中心网站就知道了。
right.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè lèi de huódòng, nǐ kàn lǚyóu zhōngxīn wǎngzhàn jiù zhīdào le.
right.english: Regarding this type of activity, check the travel center website and you will know.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我剛到臺灣，不知道有什麼適合外國人的活動。
這類的活動，你看旅遊中心的網站就知道了。

dialogue.title: 短文 · 我的面試經驗

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 一般來說，現代人找工作得經過面試。面試時表現得好，被錄取的機會就比較大。今天，我就來跟各位說說我最近面試的經驗和感想。
lines.simplified: 一般来说，现代人找工作得经过面试。面试时表现得好，被录取的机会就比较大。今天，我就来跟各位说说我最近面试的经验和感想。
lines.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, xiàndài rén zhǎo gōngzuò děi jīngguò miànshì. Miànshì shí biǎoxiàn de hǎo, bèi lùqǔ de jīhuì jiù bǐjiào dà. Jīntiān, wǒ jiù lái gēn gèwèi shuōshuo wǒ zuìjìn miànshì de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng.
lines.english: Generally speaking, modern people must go through interviews to find jobs. Performing well in an interview brings greater chances of being hired. Today, let me share my recent interview experience and thoughts with everyone.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 上個月，我在網站上，看到某家企業有銷售人員的需求，就立刻把個人資料寄過去。資料中除了說明我過去的工作經驗，也包含我對工作的看法和態度。兩個星期之後，我收到了面試通知。儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳，所以面試當天很早就醒來，出門前還一再確認穿著是不是整齊、資料是不是都放進了背包。我想，這樣又緊張又興奮的心情，往往是面試時經常有的表現。
lines.simplified: 上个月，我在网站上，看到某家企业有销售人员的需求，就立刻把个人资料寄过去。资料中除了说明我过去的工作经验，也包含我对工作的看法和态度。两个星期之后，我收到了面试通知。尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳，所以面试当天很早就醒来，出门前还一再确认穿着是不是整齐、资料是不是都放进了背包。我想，这样又紧张又兴奋的心情，往往是面试时经常有的表现。
lines.pinyin: Shàng gè yuè, wǒ zài wǎngzhàn shàng, kàndào mǒu jiā qǐyè yǒu xiāoshòu rényuán de xūqiú, jiù lìkè bǎ gèrén zīliào jì guòqù. Zīliào zhōng chúle shuōmíng wǒ guòqù de gōngzuò jīngyàn, yě bāohán wǒ duì gōngzuò de kànfǎ hé tàidù. Liǎng gè xīngqī zhīhòu, wǒ shōudào le miànshì tōngzhī. Jǐnguǎn wǒ bú shì dì-yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā, suǒyǐ miànshì dāngtiān hěn zǎo jiù xǐnglái, chūmén qián hái yízài quèrèn chuānzhuó shì bú shì zhěngqí, zīliào shì bú shì dōu fàng jìn le bèibāo. Wǒ xiǎng, zhèyàng yòu jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn de xīnqíng, wǎngwǎng shì miànshì shí jīngcháng yǒu de biǎoxiàn.
lines.english: Last month, I saw on a website that an enterprise needed sales personnel and sent my personal information immediately. Beyond outlining my past work experience, the materials covered my views and attitudes toward work. Two weeks later, I received an interview notification. Even though it wasn't my first interview, I still worried about performing poorly, so I woke up very early on the day, repeatedly verifying that my attire was neat and my materials were all packed. Such nervous yet excited feelings are often common during interviews.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 一開始，經理請我說明對銷售工作的想法。我回答他，銷售人員是最常接觸顧客的，所以對客人要有禮貌，態度也要主動，絕對不能像木頭一樣沒反應；萬一他們亂發脾氣，就該忍耐、冷靜。畢竟，只顧自己的感覺，把跟顧客的關係搞壞，讓大家都不高興，又有什麼好處呢？
lines.simplified: 一开始，经理请我说明对销售工作的想法。我回答他，销售人员是最常接触顾客的，所以对客人要有礼貌，态度也要主动，绝对不能像木头一样没反应；万一他们乱发脾气，就该忍耐、冷静。毕竟，只顾自己的感觉，把跟顾客的关系搞坏，让大家都不高兴，又有什么好处呢？
lines.pinyin: Yì kāishǐ, jīnglǐ qǐng wǒ shuōmíng duì xiāoshòu gōngzuò de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ huídá tā, xiāoshòu rényuán shì zuì cháng jiēchù gùkè de, suǒyǐ duì kèrén yào yǒu lǐmào, tàidù yě yào zhǔdòng, juéduì bù néng xiàng mùtou yíyàng méi fǎnyìng; wànyī tāmen luàn fā píqì, jiù gāi rěnnài, lěngjìng. Bìjìng, zhǐ gù zìjǐ de gǎnjué, bǎ gēn gùkè de guānxì gǎo huài, ràng dàjiā dōu bù gāoxìng, yòu yǒu shénme hǎochù ne?
lines.english: To begin, the manager asked for my thoughts on sales work. I replied that sales staff have the closest contact with customers, so one must be polite, take the initiative, and never act unresponsive like a piece of wood. If customers lose their temper, one should be patient and calm. After all, considering only one's own feelings and ruining relations with customers brings no benefit.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 後來，經理又問我對團體合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小組的方式來推銷產品，所以能理解合作是必要的。況且，主管要領導整個部門，為全公司創造好成績，要是小組人員不配合，恐怕就不能順利實行銷售計畫，也會出現混亂的情況。因此，為了公司，我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
lines.simplified: 后来，经理又问我对团体合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小组的方式来推销产品，所以能理解合作是必要的。况且，主管要领导整个部门，为全公司创造好成绩，要是小组人员不配合，恐怕就不能顺利实行销售计划，也会出现混乱的情况。因此，为了公司，我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
lines.pinyin: Hòulái, jīnglǐ yòu wèn wǒ duì tuántǐ hézuò de kànfǎ. Wǒ zhīqián de gōngzuò, jiù shì yǐ xiǎozǔ de fāngshì lái tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn, suǒyǐ néng lǐjiě hézuò shì bìyào de. Kuàngqiě, zhǔguǎn yào lǐngdǎo zhěnggè bùmén, wèi quán gōngsī chuàngzào hǎo chéngjì, yàoshi xiǎozǔ rényuán bù pèihé, kǒngpà jiù bù néng shùnlì shíxíng xiāoshòu jìhuà, yě huì chūxiàn hùnluàn de qíngkuàng. Yīncǐ, wèile gōngsī, wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
lines.english: Later, the manager asked about my views on teamwork. My previous work promoted products in teams, so I understand cooperation is essential. Moreover, supervisors lead entire departments to create results; without staff cooperation, plans cannot proceed smoothly and chaos results. Therefore, no matter what reasonable requests the supervisor makes, employees should cooperate.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 最後，經理問我要是被錄取了，能為公司付出什麼。我說，在推銷產品方面，我的經驗很豐富，商品銷售可說是我一輩子的事業，所以一定會盡最大的力量認真工作、完成任務。
lines.simplified: 最后，经理问我要是被录取了，能为公司付出什么。我说，在推销产品方面，我的经验很丰富，商品销售可说是我一辈子的事业，所以一定会尽最大的力量认真工作、完成任务。
lines.pinyin: Zuìhòu, jīnglǐ wèn wǒ yàoshi bèi lùqǔ le, néng wèi gōngsī fùchū shénme. Wǒ shuō, zài tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn fāngmiàn, wǒ de jīngyàn hěn fēngfù, shāngpǐn xiāoshòu kě shuō shì wǒ yíbèizi de shìyè, suǒyǐ yídìng huì jìn zuìdà de lìliàng rènzhēn gōngzuò, wánchéng rènwù.
lines.english: Finally, the manager asked what I could contribute to the company if hired. I stated that my experience in sales is extensive, that sales can be said to be my lifelong career, and that I would dedicate my utmost efforts to working conscientiously and accomplishing missions.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 上星期我收到了通過面試的通知，下個月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我終於美夢成真了。很多人說，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一點兒運氣。其實，個性、能力，加上不斷地努力才是最重要的。
lines.simplified: 上星期我收到了通过面试的通知，下个月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我终于美梦成真了。很多人说，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一点儿运气。其实，个性、能力，加上不断地努力才是最重要的。
lines.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī wǒ shōudào le tōngguò miànshì de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào shàngbān le. Pànwàng le hǎojiǔ, wǒ zhōngyú měimèng chéngzhēn le. Hěn duō rén shuō, xiǎng zhǎodào lǐxiǎng de gōngzuò, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào yìdiǎnr yùnqì. Qíshí, gèxìng, nénglì, jiāshàng búduàn de nǔlì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
lines.english: Last week I received notification of passing the interview, and I start next month. After longing for so long, my dream has finally come true. Many say finding an ideal job takes a bit of luck, but personality, ability, and persistent effort are truly what matter most.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 以上就是我找工作的經驗和感想，如果有任何問題，歡迎跟我聯絡，謝謝！
lines.simplified: 以上就是我找工作的经验和感想，如果有任何问题，欢迎跟我联络，谢谢！
lines.pinyin: Yǐshàng jiù shì wǒ zhǎo gōngzuò de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng, rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng gēn wǒ liánluò, xièxie!
lines.english: The above is my experience and reflection on job seeking. If you have questions, please feel free to contact me. Thank you!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: State a factual concessive condition with 儘管 to contrast against an unexpected outcome.
grammarPages.pattern: 儘管 + Fact, + (但是 / 可是 / 還是 / 卻) + Contrary Result

columns.pinyin: wǒ bú shì dì-yī cì miànshì
columns.meaning: I am not first time interviewing

columns.pinyin: yǐngxiǎng tā duì Zhōngwén de xìngqù
liú zài jiàoshì lǐ gǎi zuòyè

text.traditional: 儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳。
text.simplified: 尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳。
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒ bú shì dì-yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā.
text.english: Even though it was not my first time attending an interview, I was still worried about performing poorly.

text.traditional: 儘管他平時測驗的成績都不理想，卻不影響他對中文的興趣。
text.simplified: 尽管他平时测验的成绩都不理想，却不影响他对中文的兴趣。
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā píngshí cèyàn de chéngjī dōu bù lǐxiǎng, què bù yǐngxiǎng tā duì Zhōngwén de xìngqù.
text.english: Even though his regular quiz scores were not ideal, it did not affect his interest in Chinese.

text.traditional: 儘管已經下課了，張老師還是留在教室裡改作業，直到晚餐時間才離開。
text.simplified: 尽管已经下课了，张老师还是留在教室里改作业，直到晚餐时间才离开。
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng xiàkè le, Zhāng lǎoshī háishì liú zài jiàoshì lǐ gǎi zuòyè, zhídào wǎncān shíjiān cái líkāi.
text.english: Even though class had already dismissed, Teacher Zhang still stayed in the classroom correcting homework until dinnertime.

items.question: How is 儘管 different from 即使?
items.answer: 「儘管」引導的是已經發生的既成事實；「即使」引導的是假設性的退讓條件（即便如此……）。
items.wrongTraditional: 即使已經下課了，張老師昨天留在教室改作業。
items.wrongSimplified: 即使已经下课了，张老师昨天留在教室改作业。

right.traditional: 儘管已經下課了，張老師還是留在教室改作業。
right.simplified: 尽管已经下课了，张老师还是留在教室改作业。
right.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng xiàkè le, Zhāng lǎoshī háishì liú zài jiàoshì gǎi zuòyè.
right.english: Even though class had dismissed, Teacher Zhang still stayed in the classroom grading.

items.question: Can 儘管 pair with 但 / 還是 / 卻 in the following clause?
items.answer: 是的，「儘管」後面常搭配「但是、可是、還是、卻」以凸顯出乎意料的轉折結果。
items.wrongTraditional: 儘管平時成績不好，所以他很開心。
items.wrongSimplified: 尽管平时成绩不好，所以他很开心。

right.traditional: 儘管成績不理想，卻不影響他的興趣。
right.simplified: 尽管成绩不理想，却不影响他的兴趣。
right.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngjī bù lǐxiǎng, què bù yǐngxiǎng tā de xìngqù.
right.english: Even though grades were not ideal, it did not affect his interest.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我進公司兩年了，好像沒看過老闆生氣。是啊，
產品出現了嚴重的問題，他也沒怪任何人，脾氣真好。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「儘管」主要用來描述既成事實的讓步，後接相反的結果。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意語意關係：前半句說明「產品出現嚴重問題」之事實，後半句為轉折結果，應使用「儘管」。

grammarPages.explanation: 「儘管」是連詞，用在第一個句子的句首，主要用來描述事實或某件事的結論，與「雖然」的意思相近；後面的分句常用「可是、但是、還是、卻」，表示與前句的結果相反。

items.prompt: Colleague praises boss's temper. Note that even though serious problems occurred, he blamed no one:

segments.traditional: 出現了嚴重的問題，他也沒怪任何人。

result.traditional: 儘管產品出現了嚴重的問題，他也沒怪任何人。
result.simplified: 尽管产品出现了严重的问题，他也没怪任何人。
result.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chǎnpǐn chūxiàn le yánzhòng de wèntí, tā yě méi guài rènhé rén.
result.english: Even though serious problems appeared with the product, he didn't blame anyone.

repairs.note: Conceding a real existing fact uses 儘管.
Use 儘管 to contrast a factual premise against contrary outcome.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 儘管產品.

items.prompt: Xiao Li joined planning group. State that despite work being tough, you believe he'll persist:

segments.traditional: 很辛苦，我相信他能夠堅持到底。

result.traditional: 儘管工作很辛苦，我相信他能夠堅持到底。
result.simplified: 尽管工作很辛苦，我相信他能够坚持到底。
result.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, wǒ xiāngxìn tā nénggòu jiānchí dàodǐ.
result.english: Even though work is arduous, I believe he can persevere to the end.

repairs.note: Factual concession takes 儘管.
Use 儘管 to introduce the concessive condition 'even though'.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 儘管工作.

items.prompt: Competition is stiff. Note that even though competition is intense, Xiao Lin gives his all:

segments.traditional: 非常激烈，小林依然全力以赴。

result.traditional: 儘管競爭非常激烈，小林依然全力以赴。
result.simplified: 尽管竞争非常激烈，小林依然全力以赴。
result.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jìngzhēng fēicháng jīliè, Xiǎo Lín yīrán quánlì yǐ fù.
result.english: Even though competition is fierce, Xiao Lin still goes all out.

repairs.note: Acknowledging an actual situation uses 儘管, not 哪怕 (hypothetical).
Use 儘管 for factual concessive clauses.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 儘管競爭.

result.simplified: 尽管我不是第一次面试，但还是担心表现不佳。
result.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒ bú shì dì-yī cì miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā.
result.english: Even though it wasn't my first interview, I was still worried about performing poorly.

repairs.note: Use 儘管 to contrast a factual situation against unexpected worry.
Concessive statements of fact take 儘管.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 儘管.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that regardless of conditions, variables, or alternatives, the outcome remains invariant using 不論……都…….
grammarPages.pattern: 不論 + Variable Condition, + Subject + 都 + Invariant Result

text.traditional: 我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
text.simplified: 我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
text.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
text.english: I believe that no matter what demands the supervisor has, as long as they are reasonable, employees should cooperate.

text.traditional: 包老闆很堅持自己的想法，不論你說什麼，他都不會改變。
text.simplified: 包老板很坚持自己的想法，不论你说什么，他都不会改变。
text.pinyin: Bāo lǎobǎn hěn jiānchí zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, búlùn nǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu bú huì gǎibiàn.
text.english: Boss Bao is very stubborn about his opinions; no matter what you say, he will not change.

text.traditional: 不論你有升學或工作方面的問題，都可以請教紀伯伯，他一定能給你寶貴的意見。
text.simplified: 不论你有升学或工作方面的问题，都可以请教纪伯伯，他一定能给你宝贵的意见。
text.pinyin: Búlùn nǐ yǒu shēngxué huò gōngzuò fāngmiàn de wèntí, dōu kěyǐ qǐngjiào Jì bóbo, tā yídìng néng gěi nǐ bǎoguì de yìjiàn.
text.english: No matter whether you have questions about schooling or jobs, you can consult Uncle Ji; he will surely give you valuable advice.

words.traditional: 不論你有升學或工作問題
words.simplified: 不论你有升学或工作问题
words.pinyin: búlùn nǐ yǒu shēngxué huò gōngzuò wèntí
words.meaning: no matter if you have school or work questions

text.traditional: 我為了這次的比賽準備了很久，不論教練去不去，我都要參加。
text.simplified: 我为了这次的比赛准备了很久，不论教练去不去，我都要参加。
text.pinyin: Wǒ wèile zhè cì de bǐsài zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ, búlùn jiàoliàn qù bú qù, wǒ dōu yào cānjiā.
text.english: I prepared for this competition for a long time; regardless of whether the coach goes or not, I will participate.

words.meaning: regardless whether coach goes or not

items.question: What types of conditions follow 不論?
items.answer: 「不論」後面通常接疑問代詞（什麼、哪裡）、反義詞對舉（遠近、好壞）或正反問句（去不去），表示各種變數下結論都不變。
items.wrongTraditional: 不論教練去，我都要參加。
items.wrongSimplified: 不论教练去，我都要参加。

right.traditional: 不論教練去不去，我都要參加。
right.simplified: 不论教练去不去，我都要参加。
right.pinyin: Búlùn jiàoliàn qù bú qù, wǒ dōu yào cānjiā.
right.english: No matter whether the coach goes or not, I will participate.

items.question: How is 不論……都 different from 既然……就?
items.answer: 「不論……都」表示排除任何變數限制，結果始終恆定；「既然……就」表示在既成前題下順理成章採取對應動作。
items.wrongTraditional: 既然主管有什麼要求，員工都要配合。
items.wrongSimplified: 既然主管有什么要求，员工都要配合。

right.traditional: 不論主管有什麼要求，員工都應該配合。
right.simplified: 不论主管有什么要求，员工都应该配合。
right.pinyin: Búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
right.english: No matter what the supervisor requires, employees should cooperate.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 這是我的購物習慣，
買什麼，我都要親自檢查才安心。

questions.correctFeedback: 答得很好！「不論……都……」搭配疑問詞「什麼」，表示任何情況下結果都不變。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意條件多樣性：後接「買什麼」，後句搭配「都」，表示無條件的通則，應使用「不論」。

grammarPages.explanation: 用來表示雖然情況不同，但是最後的結果不因情況而受影響。「不論」的後面可搭配疑問詞、反義複合詞或正反問句，表示各種情況；「都」後面則是一定會出現的結果或事實。

items.prompt: Friend asks why you buy in stores. Explain that no matter what you buy, you must check personally:

segments.traditional: 買什麼我都得親自檢查才安心。

result.traditional: 這是我的習慣，不論買什麼我都得親自檢查才安心。
result.simplified: 这是我的习惯，不论买什么我都得亲自检查才安心。
result.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de xíguàn, búlùn mǎi shénme wǒ dōu děi qīnzì jiǎnchá cái ānxīn.
result.english: This is my habit; no matter what I buy, I must check it personally to feel at ease.

repairs.note: Invariance over alternatives takes 不論……都.
Use 不論 with question words like 什麼 to denote 'regardless of what'.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不論.

items.prompt: Up at 2 AM. Explain that no matter how tired, you must finish your term paper tonight:

result.traditional: 期末報告明天交，今晚不論多累我都得完成。
result.simplified: 期末报告明天交，今晚不论多累我都得完成。
result.pinyin: Qímò bàogào míngtiān jiāo, jīnwǎn búlùn duō lèi wǒ dōu děi wánchéng.
result.english: The term paper is due tomorrow; tonight no matter how tired I am, I must finish.

repairs.note: Unconditional resolve uses 不論……都.
Pair 不論 with degree word 多累 to express invariant necessity.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不論多累.

items.prompt: Important meeting tomorrow. State that no matter how late, materials must be prepared:

result.traditional: 明天的會議很重要，不論多晚我都得把資料準備好。
result.simplified: 明天的会议很重要，不论多晚我都得把资料准备好。
result.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì hěn zhòngyào, búlùn duō wǎn wǒ dōu děi bǎ zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo.
result.english: Tomorrow's meeting is crucial; no matter how late it is, I must prepare the materials.

repairs.note: Invariance over degree takes 不論.
Use 不論……都 to express 'regardless of how late'.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不論多晚.

items.prompt: Player is praised for academics and sports. State that regardless of coach attending, you will join:

segments.traditional: 教練去不去我都要參加比賽。

result.traditional: 我準備了很久，不論教練去不去我都要參加比賽。
result.simplified: 我准备了很久，不论教练去不去我都要参加比赛。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ, búlùn jiàoliàn qù bú qù wǒ dōu yào cānjiā bǐsài.
result.english: I prepared for a long time; regardless of whether the coach goes or not, I will participate in the competition.

repairs.note: Use 不論 with affirmative-negative choice 去不去.
Invariance with A-not-A conditions takes 不論.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不論.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · Cloud Technology Is Really Convenient

dialogue.title: 雲端科技真方便

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 明哲，你不要一直看手機啦。
lines.simplified: 明哲，你不要一直看手机啦。
lines.pinyin: Míngzhé, nǐ bú yào yìzhí kàn shǒujī la.
lines.english: Mingzhe, don't keep staring at your phone all the time.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我在查借書記錄，看看雲端圖書館的電子書還能借多久。
lines.simplified: 我在查借书记录，看看云端图书馆的电子书还能借多久。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài chá jiè shū jìlù, kànkan yúnduān túshūguǎn de diànzǐshū hái néng jiè duō jiǔ.
lines.english: I'm checking my borrowing record to see how much longer I can keep the cloud library e-book.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我從來沒用過雲端圖書館系統，你可以教我嗎？
lines.simplified: 我从来没用过云端图书馆系统，你可以教我吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi yòngguo yúnduān túshūguǎn xìtǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
lines.english: I have never used the cloud library system before. Could you teach me?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 妳只要上雲端圖書館的網站填資料，建立帳號、密碼，就能用了。
lines.simplified: 你只要上云端图书馆的网站填资料，建立账号、密码，就能用了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐyào shàng yúnduān túshūguǎn de wǎngzhàn tián zīliào, jiànlì zhànghào, mìmǎ, jiù néng yòng le.
lines.english: You just need to fill in information on the cloud library website and create an account and password, then you can use it.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 聽起來不難嘛！什麼時候借都可以嗎？
lines.simplified: 听起来不难嘛！什么时候借都可以吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái bù nán ma! Shénme shíhou jiè dōu kěyǐ ma?
lines.english: Sounds easy! Can you borrow anytime?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 是啊，而且還書時間一到，系統就會自動還書。不像以前，想借書只能親自跑一趟圖書館，要是多借了幾本，還得抱著一堆書回家。
lines.simplified: 是啊，而且还书时间一到，系统就会自动还书。不像以前，想借书只能亲自跑一趟图书馆，要是多借了几本，还得抱着一堆书回家。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě huán shū shíjiān yí dào, xìtǒng jiù huì zìdòng huán shū. Bù xiàng yǐqián, xiǎng jiè shū zhǐ néng qīnzì pǎo yí tàng túshūguǎn, yàoshi duō jiè le jǐ běn, hái děi bàozhe yì duī shū huí jiā.
lines.english: Yes, and as soon as the due date arrives, the system returns it automatically. Unlike before, when borrowing required a trip to the library, and borrowing several books meant lugging a stack home.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 現在的讀者實在太幸福了。
lines.simplified: 现在的读者实在太幸福了。
lines.pinyin: Xiàndài de dúzhě shízài tài xìngfú le.
lines.english: Modern readers are truly fortunate.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 就是啊，只要帶著手機或平板，就能隨時隨地閱讀了。
lines.simplified: 就是啊，只要带着手机或平板，就能随时随地阅读了。
lines.pinyin: Jiù shì a, zhǐyào dàizhe shǒujī huò píngbǎn, jiù néng suíshí suídì yuèdú le.
lines.english: Exactly; as long as you carry a phone or tablet, you can read anytime, anywhere.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 這樣我的書包就能變得很空，放得下外套、雨傘什麼的。
lines.simplified: 这样我的书包就能变得很空，放得下外套、雨伞什么的。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng wǒ de shūbāo jiù néng biàn de hěn kōng, fàng de xià wàitào, yǔsǎn shénme de.
lines.english: That way my schoolbag can become very spacious, leaving room for a coat, umbrella, and so on.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 是啊。現在我什麼文件都存在雲端，要是忘了帶隨身碟也不必擔心。
lines.simplified: 是啊。现在我什么文件都存在云端，要是忘了带随身碟也不必担心。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ shénme wénjiàn dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàoshi wàng le dài suíshēndié yě bú bì dānxīn.
lines.english: Indeed. Now I store all documents in the cloud; even if I forget my flash drive, there is no need to worry.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 有一次小組發表報告前五分鐘，我發現忘了帶隨身碟，也沒把預備好的資料寄到同學的電子信箱。我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份，問題就馬上解決了。
lines.simplified: 有一次小组发表报告前五分钟，我发现忘了带随身碟，也没把预备好的资料寄到同学的电子信箱。我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份，问题就马上解决了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì xiǎozǔ fābiǎo bàogào qián wǔ fēnzhōng, wǒ fāxiàn wàng le dài suíshēndié, yě méi bǎ yùbèi hǎo de zīliào jì dào tóngxué de diànzǐ xìnxīang. Wǒ nà shíhou xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méi bànfǎ bàogào le, hái hǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn, wèntí jiù mǎshàng jiějué le.
lines.english: Once, five minutes before our group presentation, I found I had forgotten my flash drive and hadn't emailed the prepared files to classmates. I thought, 'Now we can't present!' Luckily a classmate said there was a copy on the cloud, and the problem was resolved immediately.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 現在的網路科技水平提高了不少，企業能透過高速網路把資料上傳到雲端處理，不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
lines.simplified: 现在的网络科技水平提高了不少，企业能透过高速网络把资料上传到云端处理，不同地区的人也能在网络上一起开会，既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài de wǎnglù kējì shuǐpíng tígāo le bù shǎo, qǐyè néng tòuguò gāosù wǎnglù bǎ zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān chǔlǐ, bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn, gèng bié shuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxí děng jīběn fúwù le.
lines.english: Internet technology standards have improved considerably. Enterprises can upload data to the cloud via high-speed internet for processing, and people in different regions can meet online—saving time and being convenient, not to mention basic personal services like downloads and messaging.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 除了這些優點，雲端還能把會議資料自動存起來，也能把變更的時間和內容記錄下來，讓不能參加會議的人隨時掌握最新情況。
lines.simplified: 除了这些优点，云端还能把会议资料自动存起来，也能把变更的时间和内容记录下来，让不能参加会议的人随时掌握最新情况。
lines.pinyin: Chúle zhèxiē yōudiǎn, yúnduān hái néng bǎ huìyì zīliào zìdòng cún qǐlái, yě néng bǎ biàngēng de shíjiān hé nèiróng jìlù xiàlái, ràng bù néng cānjiā huìyì de rén suíshí zhǎowò zuìxīn qíngkuàng.
lines.english: Besides these merits, the cloud automatically archives meeting materials and logs change times and details, enabling absent members to keep abreast of updates anytime.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 其實也有不少老師利用這樣的科技，把教材放上雲端，讓學生預習、複習，提高學習的效果。
lines.simplified: 其实也有不少老师利用这样的科技，把教材放上云端，让学生预习、复习，提高学习的效果。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí yě yǒu bù shǎo lǎoshī lìyòng zhèyàng de kējì, bǎ jiàocái fàng shàng yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí, fùxí, tígāo xuéxí de xiàoguǒ.
lines.english: Actually, quite a few teachers use this technology, putting course materials on the cloud for students to preview and review, boosting learning efficacy.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 不過，我覺得要利用雲端科技來改變傳統的教學方式，恐怕說起來容易，做起來不簡單吧。
lines.simplified: 不过，我觉得要利用云端科技来改变传统的教学方式，恐怕说起来容易，做起来不简单吧。
lines.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ juéde yào lìyòng yúnduān kējì lái gǎibiàn chuántǒng de jiàoxué fāngshì, kǒngpà shuōqǐlái róngyì, zuòqǐlái bù jiǎndān ba.
lines.english: However, using cloud technology to transform conventional teaching methods is probably easier said than done.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 明天系主任邀請馬博士來演講，題目跟雲端科技有關，妳要一起去嗎？
lines.simplified: 明天系主任邀请马博士来演讲，题目跟云端科技有关，你要一起去吗？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān xì zhǔrèn yāoqǐng Mǎ bóshì lái yǎnjiǎng, tímù gēn yúnduān kējì yǒuguān, nǐ yào yìqǐ qù ma?
lines.english: Tomorrow the department chair invited Dr. Ma to give a lecture on cloud tech. Do you want to go together?

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 說實話，我本來對雲端科技沒什麼興趣，今天聽你說了這麼多，似乎該研究一下了。
lines.simplified: 说实话，我本来对云端科技没什么兴趣，今天听你说了这么多，似乎该研究一下了。
lines.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wǒ běnlái duì yúnduān kējì méi shénme xìngqù, jīntiān tīng nǐ shuō le zhème duō, sìhū gāi yánjiū yíxià le.
lines.english: Honestly, I initially had little interest in cloud tech, but hearing you share so much today, it seems I should look into it.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 那我明天騎摩托車去接妳。
lines.simplified: 那我明天骑摩托车去接你。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ míngtiān qí mótuōchē qù jiē nǐ.
lines.english: Then I'll pick you up on my scooter tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 太好了！麻煩你了！
lines.simplified: 太好了！麻烦你了！
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Máfan nǐ le!
lines.english: Wonderful! Thanks so much!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an immediate realization, reaction, or consequence of a sudden situation using 這下子 ('now / as a result').
grammarPages.explanation: 在對話中說到某件事情或情況，說話的人表達自己的看法，也可以是自己面對突然發生的情況，當下做出的反應。
grammarPages.pattern: Event / Situation, + 這下子 + Subject + Reaction / Result

text.traditional: 我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份。
text.simplified: 我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nà shíhou xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méi bànfǎ bàogào le, hái hǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn.
text.english: I thought at that moment, 'Now we have no way to present,' but thankfully a classmate said there was also a copy on the cloud.

words.pinyin: yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn

text.traditional: 我們工廠早上突然停電了，什麼都做不了。真的？這下子你們的貨趕得出來嗎？
text.simplified: 我们工厂早上突然停电了，什么都做不了。真的？这下子你们的货赶得出来吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngchǎng zǎoshang tūrán tíngdiàn le, shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo. Zhēn de? Zhèxiàzi nǐmen de huò gǎn de chūlái ma?
text.english: Our factory suddenly lost power this morning and we couldn't do anything. Really? Now can you still finish the goods in time?

text.traditional: 沒想到小顧要旅遊的國家昨天發生了大地震。是啊，這下子他得改變計畫了。
text.simplified: 没想到小顾要旅游的国家昨天发生了大地震。是啊，这下子他得改变计划了。
text.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào Xiǎo Gù yào lǚyóu de guójiā zuótiān fāshēng le dà dìzhèn. Shì a, zhèxiàzi tā děi gǎibiàn jìhuà le.
text.english: Unexpectedly the country Xiao Gu planned to visit suffered a major earthquake yesterday. Yes, now he has to change his plans.

items.question: When should you use 這下子 instead of simple 現在?
items.answer: 「這下子」強調事情發生後的即刻後果或對突發情境的強烈感嘆反應；「現在」僅客觀表示當前時間。
items.wrongTraditional: 早上工廠停電了，現在你們的貨趕得出來嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 早上工厂停电了，现在你们的货赶得出来吗？

right.traditional: 工廠突然停電，這下子貨趕得出來嗎？
right.simplified: 工厂突然停电，这下子货赶得出来吗？
right.pinyin: Gōngchǎng tūrán tíngdiàn, zhèxiàzi huò gǎn de chūlái ma?
right.english: The factory suddenly lost power; now can the goods be rushed out in time?

words.pinyin: zhèxiàzi huò gǎn de chūlái ma

items.question: Can 這下子 be used for anticipated pleasant or unpleasant emergent turns?
items.answer: 兩者皆可，但在口語中常帶有「這下可麻煩了」或面對意外轉折的強烈情緒色彩。
items.wrongTraditional: 天氣很好，這下子我明天去學校。
items.wrongSimplified: 天气很好，这下子我明天去学校。

right.traditional: 突然下大雨沒帶傘，這下子走不成了。
right.simplified: 突然下大雨没带伞，这下子走不成了。
right.pinyin: Tūrán xià dàyǔ méi dài sǎn, zhèxiàzi zǒu bù chéng le.
right.english: Sudden heavy rain and no umbrella—now we can't leave.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 下課了突然下起大雨，大家都沒帶傘，
我們只能在學校等雨停了。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「這下子」用於面對突發情況時當下做出的即時反應與感慨。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意突發事件的因果關係：面對突發大雨沒有雨傘的處境，應使用「這下子」。

items.prompt: Factory lost power and nothing can run. Colleague asks anxiously if goods can still be delivered in time:

result.traditional: 工廠突然停電，這下子你們的貨趕得出來嗎？
result.simplified: 工厂突然停电，这下子你们的货赶得出来吗？
result.pinyin: Gōngchǎng tūrán tíngdiàn, zhèxiàzi nǐmen de huò gǎn de chūlái ma?
result.english: The factory suddenly lost power; now can your goods still be produced in time?

repairs.note: Reacting to a sudden emergent situation takes 這下子.
Use 這下子 to express an emergent reaction in the situation.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這下子.

result.traditional: 當地發生了大地震，這下子他得改變行程了。
result.simplified: 当地发生了大地震，这下子他得改变行程了。
result.pinyin: Dāngdì fāshēng le dà dìzhèn, zhèxiàzi tā děi gǎibiàn xíngchéng le.
result.english: A major earthquake struck there; now he must change his itinerary.

repairs.note: Use 這下子 for sudden situational turns requiring adjustments.
Immediate reaction to sudden circumstances takes 這下子.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這下子.

result.traditional: 大家都沒帶傘，這下子我們只能在學校等了。
result.simplified: 大家都没带伞，这下子我们只能在学校等了。
result.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu méi dài sǎn, zhèxiàzi wǒmen zhǐ néng zài xuéxiào děng le.
result.english: Nobody brought an umbrella; now we can only wait at school.

repairs.note: Immediate reaction to a sudden predicament takes 這下子.
Use 這下子 to express facing an unexpected predicament on the spot.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 這下子.

items.prompt: Forgot USB and didn't email presentation. Describe your initial shock that you couldn't report:

result.traditional: 我那時候心想，這下子沒辦法上臺報告了。
result.simplified: 我那时候心想，这下子没办法上台报告了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ nà shíhou xīnxǐng, zhèxiàzi méi bànfǎ shàngtái bàogào le.
result.english: I thought to myself at that time, 'Now there's no way to present!'

repairs.note: Describe sudden distress on the spot using 這下子.
Use 這下子 for sudden emergent consequence realizations.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Coordinate two simultaneous positive or negative qualities/actions using 既……又…….
grammarPages.explanation: 表示同一個主語具有兩種狀態或情況。「既」跟「又」後面常接形容詞、動詞或動詞短語。所連接的兩個狀態或情況，必須同樣是正面的或負面的。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 既 + State/Action 1 + 又 + State/Action 2

text.traditional: 不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便。
text.simplified: 不同地区的人也能在网络上一起开会，既省时间又方便。
text.pinyin: Bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn.
text.english: People from diverse areas can also hold meetings online, saving time as well as being convenient.

text.traditional: 那家網路服裝店的衣服既好看又便宜，吸引了不少年輕人。
text.simplified: 那家网络服装店的衣服既好看又便宜，吸引了不少年轻人。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā wǎnglù fúzhuāng diàn de yīfu jì hǎokàn yòu piányi, xīyǐn le bù shǎo niánqīng rén.
text.english: The clothes at that online shop are both good-looking and inexpensive, attracting many youths.

text.traditional: 到偏遠地區教書，既能挑戰新生活，又能打開自己的視野。
text.simplified: 到偏远地区教书，既能挑战新生活，又能打开自己的视野。
text.pinyin: Dào piānyuǎn dìqū jiāoshū, jì néng tiǎozhàn xīn shēnghuó, yòu néng dǎkāi zìjǐ de shìyě.
text.english: Teaching in remote regions can both challenge one with new experiences and broaden one's horizon.

items.question: Can 既 and 又 pair opposite polarities (one positive, one negative)?
items.answer: 不行。「既……又……」連接的兩個性質必須同為正面（褒義）或同為負面（貶義）。
items.wrongTraditional: 這件衣服既漂亮又很難看。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件衣服既漂亮又很难看。

right.traditional: 這件衣服既好看又便宜。
right.simplified: 这件衣服既好看又便宜。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu jì hǎokàn yòu piányi.
right.english: This piece of clothing is both nice-looking and affordable.

items.question: Can degree adverbs like 很 precede adjectives after 既 / 又?
items.answer: 通常不加副詞「很」，直接接單純形容詞（如「既省時間又方便」，不說「既很省時間又很方便」）。
items.wrongTraditional: 網上開會既很省時又很方便。
items.wrongSimplified: 网上开会既很省时又很方便。

right.traditional: 網上開會既省時又方便。
right.simplified: 网上开会既省时又方便。
right.pinyin: Wǎngshàng kāihuì jì shěngshí yòu fāngbiàn.
right.english: Online meetings are both time-saving and convenient.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 不同地區的人在網路上開會，
省時間又方便。

questions.correctFeedback: 答對了！「既……又……」表示同時具備兩種同向性質或特點。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意句式搭配：後句有「又方便」，前半句應搭配「既省時間」。

items.prompt: Colleague praises online meetings. State that meeting online is both time-saving and convenient:

result.traditional: 在網路上開會，既省時間又很方便。
result.simplified: 在网络上开会，既省时间又很方便。
result.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shàng kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu hěn fāngbiàn.
result.english: Meeting online is both time-saving and convenient.

repairs.note: Pairing parallel positive traits takes 既……又.
Use 既 before the first quality to pair with 又.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 既.

items.prompt: Recommend online boutique. Affirm that the clothes are good-looking and affordable:

result.traditional: 那家店的衣服既好看又便宜，很多人買。
result.simplified: 那家店的衣服既好看又便宜，很多人买。
result.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de yīfu jì hǎokàn yòu piányi, hěn duō rén mǎi.
result.english: The clothes at that shop are both stylish and affordable; many people buy them.

repairs.note: Both traits are positive; pair 既 with 又.
Correlative pair for parallel traits is 既……又.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 又.

items.prompt: Asked why teach in countryside. State that it challenges life and opens new horizons:

segments.traditional: 去鄉下教書，既能挑戰生活，

result.traditional: 去鄉下教書，既能挑戰生活，又能開拓個人視野。
result.simplified: 去乡下教书，既能挑战生活，又能开拓个人视野。
result.pinyin: Qù xiāngxià jiāoshū, jì néng tiǎozhàn shēnghuó, yòu néng kāituò gèrén shìyě.
result.english: Teaching in the countryside can both challenge one's life and broaden one's horizon.

repairs.note: Pairing complementary gains uses 既……又.
Correlative paired clause takes 既……又.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 又.

items.prompt: Friend asks why buy at department store. Point out it allows instant trying on and alterations:

segments.traditional: 專櫃服裝既能馬上試穿，

result.traditional: 專櫃服裝既能馬上試穿，又能現場修改大小。
result.simplified: 专柜服装既能马上试穿，又能现场修改大小。
result.pinyin: Zhuānguì fúzhuāng jì néng mǎshàng shìchuān, yòu néng xiànchǎng xiūgǎi dàxiǎo.
result.english: Department store clothes can be tried on immediately and altered on site.

repairs.note: The correlative structure is 既……又.
Parallel advantages take 既……又, not adversative 但.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 又.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Dismiss obvious, self-evident follow-ups using 更別說 ('not to mention / let alone').
grammarPages.explanation: 「更別說」的意思是「不必說」、「不需要說」，因為「更別說」後面所表達的情況是非常清楚的，不需要再多說。
grammarPages.pattern: Basic Case, + 更別說 + Advanced Case + 了

columns.traditional: 在網路開會既省時又方便
columns.simplified: 在网络开会既省时又方便
columns.pinyin: zài wǎnglù kāihuì jì shěngshí yòu fāngbiàn

columns.traditional: 提供下載資料等基本服務了
columns.simplified: 提供下载资料等基本服务了
columns.pinyin: tígōng xiàzài zīliào děng jīběn fúwù le

columns.traditional: 奶奶連上傳資料都不會
columns.simplified: 奶奶连上传资料都不会
columns.pinyin: nǎinai lián shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì

columns.traditional: 見到陌生人害羞得說不出話
columns.simplified: 见到陌生人害羞得说不出话
columns.pinyin: jiàndào mòshēngrén hàixiū de shuō bù chū huà

columns.traditional: 要他在大家面前演講了
columns.simplified: 要他在大家面前演讲了
columns.pinyin: yào tā zài dàjiā miànqián yǎnjiǎng le

text.traditional: 不同地區的人能在網路上開會，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
text.simplified: 不同地区的人能在网络上开会，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
text.pinyin: Bùtóng dìqū de rén néng zài wǎnglù shàng kāihuì, gèng bié shuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxí děng jīběn fúwù le.
text.english: People from different areas can meet online, not to mention basic services like personal downloads and messaging.

text.traditional: 我奶奶連怎麼上傳資料都不會，更別說建立自己的網站了。
text.simplified: 我奶奶连怎么上传资料都不会，更别说建立自己的网站了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai lián zěnme shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì, gèng bié shuō jiànlì zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn le.
text.english: My grandma doesn't even know how to upload files, let alone build her own website.

words.pinyin: lián shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì

text.traditional: 溫先生一見到陌生人，就害羞得說不出話來，更別說要他演講了。
text.simplified: 温先生一见到陌生人，就害羞得说不出话来，更别说要他演讲了。
text.pinyin: Wēn xiānshēng yí jiàndào mòshēngrén, jiù hàixiū de shuō bù chū huà lái, gèng bié shuō yào tā yǎnjiǎng le.
text.english: Mr. Wen gets tongue-tied with shyness as soon as he sees a stranger, let alone giving a speech.

words.pinyin: hàixiū de shuō bù chū huà
words.meaning: shy to the point of speechless

items.question: How is 更別說 structured with lesser vs. greater extremes?
items.answer: 前句先提出較容易或基本的情境（常搭配『連……都……』），「更別說」後則接難度更高或更極端、顯而易見的事情。
items.wrongTraditional: 他建立網站都不會，更別說上傳資料了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他建立网站都不会，更别说上传资料了。

right.traditional: 他連上傳資料都不會，更別說建網站了。
right.simplified: 他连上传资料都不会，更别说建网站了。
right.pinyin: Tā lián shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì, gèng bié shuō jiàn wǎngzhàn le.
right.english: He doesn't even know how to upload files, let alone build a site.

items.question: Can 更別說 be replaced by 只要 or 除非?
items.answer: 不行。「更別說」表示遞進排除（不必說也知道），不可與假設連詞混淆。
items.wrongTraditional: 連房租都付不起，除非出國旅遊了。
items.wrongSimplified: 连房租都付不起，除非出国旅游了。

right.traditional: 連房租都付不起，更別說出國旅遊了。
right.simplified: 连房租都付不起，更别说出国旅游了。
right.pinyin: Lián fángzū dōu fù bù qǐ, gèng bié shuō chūguó lǚyóu le.
right.english: Can't even afford rent, let alone travel abroad.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 小古已經三個月沒工作了，連房租都付不起，
出國旅遊了。

questions.correctFeedback: 答得很棒！「更別說」引出顯而易見更不可能成立的極端情況。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意邏輯遞進：前半句指出連基本房租都付不起，後續更奢華的出國旅遊自然更不可能，應使用「更別說」。

items.prompt: Xiao Gu has no job and can't pay rent. Dismiss the idea of him travelling abroad:

result.traditional: 他連房租都付不起，更別說出國去旅遊了。
result.simplified: 他连房租都付不起，更别说出国去旅游了。
result.pinyin: Tā lián fángzū dōu fù bù qǐ, gèng bié shuō chūguó qù lǚyóu le.
result.english: He can't even afford rent, let alone travel abroad.

repairs.note: Dismissing a further self-evident extreme takes 更別說.
Use 更別說 to express 'not to mention / let alone'.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 更別說.

items.prompt: Sister fears water and won't wade at beach. State that deep sea diving is out of the question:

result.traditional: 她海邊玩水都不敢，更別說去深海潛水了。
result.simplified: 她海边玩水都不敢，更别说去深海潜水了。
result.pinyin: Tā hǎibiān wán shuǐ dōu bù gǎn, gèng bié shuō qù shēnhǎi qiánshuǐ le.
result.english: She doesn't even dare paddle at the beach, let alone go deep-sea diving.

repairs.note: Use 更別說 after a lesser negation to exclude an extreme.
Saying 'let alone' in progressive exclusion takes 更別說.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 更別說.

items.prompt: Grandma can't even upload photos. State that building her own website is far beyond reach:

segments.traditional: 奶奶連上傳照片都不會，

result.traditional: 奶奶連上傳照片都不會，更別說建立自己的網站了。
result.simplified: 奶奶连上传照片都不会，更别说建立自己的网站了。
result.pinyin: Nǎinai lián shàngchuán zhàopiàn dōu bú huì, gèng bié shuō jiànlì zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn le.
result.english: Grandma doesn't even know how to upload photos, let alone build her own website.

repairs.note: Use 更別說 to dismiss an advanced capability when basic fails.
Extending beyond a failed baseline takes 更別說.

result.traditional: 他見到生人就害羞，更別說上臺對大家演講了。
result.simplified: 他见到生人就害羞，更别说上台对大家演讲了。
result.pinyin: Tā jiàndào shēngrén jiù hàixiū, gèng bié shuō shàngtái duì dàjiā yǎnjiǎng le.
result.english: He feels shy just meeting strangers, let alone getting on stage to lecture everyone.

items.title: Grammar 4–5 · Towards The New Cloud Era

dialogue.title: 短文 · 走向雲端的新時代

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 想當年還沒有雲端科技時，人們不論想閱讀某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某類題材的文章，都得到圖書館去查資料、借書。不過，自從有了雲端之後，人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
lines.simplified: 想当年还没有云端科技时，人们不论想阅读某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某类题材的文章，都得到图书馆去查资料、借书。不过，自从有了云端之后，人们就是不出门，也可透过网络满足相关的需求。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng dāngnián hái méiyǒu yúnduān kējì shí, rénmen búlùn xiǎng yuèdú mǒu wèi zuòzhě chūbǎn de zuòpǐn, huòshì xūyào zhǎo mǒu lèi tícái de wénzhāng, dōu děi dào túshūguǎn qù chá zīliào, jiè shū. Búguò, zìcóng yǒu le yúnduān zhīhòu, rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
lines.english: Back in the days before cloud technology, whether people wanted to read works published by an author or find articles on a topic, they had to go to libraries to research and borrow books. Since the advent of the cloud, however, people can satisfy relevant needs online without leaving home.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 雲端科技的主要功能，是讓人們能隨時隨地上傳或下載資料；也因為不需要使用紙、筆來記錄，還能為地球的環保盡一份力量。以往，雲端科技多用來管理資料和電子郵件；現在遇到淹水、颱風的特殊情況，不出門也能在家開會或學習，把該做的事情都做好。上班族在家中裝上了攝影機，透過手機或電腦能看到家人的活動情況，要是他們碰上了麻煩，就能立刻請鄰居或警察協助。除了個人，企業在管理公共空間或服務方面也用得著雲端。比如說，旅館透過雲端掌握房客進出的情況、調整房間內冷氣的強弱等等。以上都是雲端科技帶來的好處。
lines.simplified: 云端科技的主要功能，是让人们能随时随地上传或下载资料；也因为不需要使用纸、笔来记录，还能为地球的环保尽一份力量。以往，云端科技多用来管理资料和电子邮件；现在遇到淹水、台风的特殊情况，不出门也能在家开会或学习，把该做的事情都做好。上班族在家中装上了摄影机，透过手机或电脑能看到家人的活动情况，要是他们碰上了麻烦，就能立刻请邻居或警察协助。除了个人，企业在管理公共空间或服务方面也用得着云端。比如说，旅馆透过云端掌握房客进出的情况、调整房间内冷气的强弱等等。以上都是云端科技带来的好处。
lines.pinyin: Yúnduān kējì de zhǔyào gōngnéng, shì ràng rénmen néng suíshí suídì shàngchuán huò xiàzài zīliào; yě yīnwèi bù xūyào shǐyòng zhǐ, bǐ lái jìlù, hái néng wèi dìqiú de huánbǎo jìn yí fèn lìliàng. Yǐwǎng, yúnduān kējì duō yòng lái guǎnlǐ zīliào hé diànzǐ yóujiàn; xiànzài yùdào yānshuǐ, táifēng de tèshū qíngkuàng, bù chūmén yě néng zài jiā kāihuì huò xuéxí, bǎ gāi zuò de shìqing dōu zuò hǎo. Shàngbānzú zài jiā zhōng zhuāng shàng le shèyǐngjī, tòuguò shǒujī huò diànnǎo néng kàndào jiārén de huódòng qíngkuàng, yàoshi tāmen pèng shàng le máfan, jiù néng lìkè qǐng línjū huò jǐngchá xiézhù. Chúle gèrén, qǐyè zài guǎnlǐ gōnggòng kōngjiān huò fúwù fāngmiàn yě yòng de zháo yúnduān. Bǐrú shuō, lǚguǎn tòuguò yúnduān zhǎowò fángkè jìnchū de qíngkuàng, tiáozhěng fángjiān nèi lěngqì de qiángruò děngděng. Yǐshàng dōu shì yúnduān kējì dàilái de hǎochù.
lines.english: The primary function of cloud tech is enabling people to upload and download data anywhere, anytime; avoiding paper and pen also contributes to environmental conservation. Previously used mainly for data and email management, during flooding or typhoons it allows remote meetings and studies. Commuters can view household activity via cameras on phone or PC and seek prompt assistance if issues arise. Beyond individuals, businesses utilize the cloud for public space and service management—hotels track guest movements and adjust AC levels. All these are benefits brought by cloud technology.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 但話說回來，雖然雲端的優點不少，卻還是有現實的問題需要克服。例如某個時刻突然停電了，或是連不上網路，再重要的會議也只能暫時停下來；也可能因為雲端系統出現安全問題，上傳的資料突然沒了或被偷了。所以最好別太依靠雲端，重要資料也應多存一份。
lines.simplified: 但话说回来，虽然云端的优点不少，却还是有现实的问题需要克服。例如某个时刻突然停电了，或是连不上网络，再重要的会议也只能暂时停下来；也可能因为云端系统出现安全问题，上传的资料突然没了或被偷了。所以最好别太依靠云端，重要资料也应多存一份。
lines.pinyin: Dàn huàshuōhuílái, suīrán yúnduān de yōudiǎn bù shǎo, què háishì yǒu xiànshí de wèntí xūyào kèfú. Lìrú mǒu ge shíkè tūrán tíngdiàn le, huòshì lián bú shàng wǎnglù, zài zhòngyào de huìyì yě zhǐ néng zhànshí tíng xiàlái; yě kěnéng yīnwèi yúnduān xìtǒng chūxiàn ānquán wèntí, shàngchuán de zīliào tūrán méi le huò bèi tōu le. Suǒyǐ zuìhǎo bié tài yīkào yúnduān, zhòngyào zīliào yě yīng duō cún yí fèn.
lines.english: Then again, though the cloud offers many perks, practical challenges persist. A sudden power outage or connectivity failure halts even crucial meetings; security breaches can cause uploaded files to vanish or be compromised. Hence one should not rely solely on the cloud and keep duplicate backups of essential data.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 雲端就像一張大網，把各種資源連在一起，提供各式各樣的服務，一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式，對全球商業、教育、文化等方面都產生了重大的影響，相信未來雲端能夠帶領我們走向美好的新時代。
lines.simplified: 云端就像一张大网，把各种资源连在一起，提供各式各样的服务，一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式，对全球商业、教育、文化等方面都产生了重大的影响，相信未来云端能够带领我们走向美好的新时代。
lines.pinyin: Yúnduān jiù xiàng yì zhāng dà wǎng, bǎ gèzhǒng zīyuán lián zài yìqǐ, tígōng gèshì gèyàng de fúwù, yì fāngmiàn dài gěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó, yì fāngmiàn yě dài gěi qǐyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, duì quánqiú shāngyè, jiàoyù, wénhuà děng fāngmiàn dōu chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng, xiāngxìn wèilái yúnduān nénggòu dàilǐng wǒmen zǒuxiàng měihǎo de xīn shídài.
lines.english: The cloud is like an immense web linking diverse resources to deliver myriad services. It brings convenience to people while equipping enterprises with refined management, exerting profound impact across global business, education, and culture, and guiding us toward a prosperous new era.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an extreme hypothetical condition that cannot change the outcome using 就是……也…… ('even if... still...').
grammarPages.explanation: 「就是」的後面是假設的情況，就算發生這些情況，「也」後面的結果也不會因為這樣而改變。
grammarPages.pattern: 就是 + Hypothetical Extreme Condition, + (Subject) + 也 + Result

text.traditional: 自從有了雲端之後，人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
text.simplified: 自从有了云端之后，人们就是不出门，也可透过网络满足相关的需求。
text.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le yúnduān zhīhòu, rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
text.english: Since having the cloud, even if people don't step out the door, they can satisfy relevant needs through the internet.

text.traditional: 為了追求夢想，就是吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
text.simplified: 为了追求梦想，就是吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。
text.pinyin: Wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng, jiùshì chī zài duō kǔ, wǒ yě yào jiānchí dàodǐ.
text.english: In order to pursue my dream, even if I suffer more hardships, I will persist to the very end.

words.meaning: I also will persist to the end

text.traditional: 林老闆既然做了決定就不會改變，就是總統來跟他說也沒用。
text.simplified: 林老板既然做了决定就不会改变，就是总统来跟他说明没用。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎobǎn jìrán zuò le juédìng jiù bú huì gǎibiàn, jiùshì zǒngtǒng lái gēn tā shuō yě méi yòng.
text.english: Since Boss Lin made the decision he won't change it; even if the president comes to talk to him, it would be useless.

words.pinyin: zuò le juédìng bú huì gǎibiàn

items.question: How is 就是……也 different from 只要……就?
items.answer: 「就是……也」表示縱使在極端假設下，結果依然不改；「只要……就」表示充分條件（只要A達成，就必然出現B）。
items.wrongTraditional: 只要吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
items.wrongSimplified: 只要吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。

right.traditional: 就是吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
right.simplified: 就是吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。
right.pinyin: Jiùshì chī zài duō kǔ, wǒ yě yào jiānchí dàodǐ.
right.english: Even if I suffer more hardships, I will still persist to the end.

items.question: Can 就是 be used interchangeably with 即使 in this concessive structure?
items.answer: 可以，「就是……也……」在口語中與「即使……也……」意思相通，極具口語強調色彩。
items.wrongTraditional: 除非吃很多苦，我也堅持到底。
items.wrongSimplified: 除非吃很多苦，我也坚持到底。

right.traditional: 就是下雪了，我們也不會改變行程。
right.simplified: 就是下雪了，我们也不会改变行程。
right.pinyin: Jiùshì xiàxuě le, wǒmen yě bú huì gǎibiàn xíngchéng.
right.english: Even if it snows, we still won't change our itinerary.

questions.repairFeedback: 請注意句意：縱使承受再多辛苦也要堅持，後句搭配「也」，應使用「就是」。
