grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Cherishing Food Starts with You and Me
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 於是 to introduce an action consciously taken in direct response to a preceding situation.
grammarPages.explanation: 「於是」是連詞，連接前後兩個句子，後句是因為前句的情況而採取的行動。注意自然現象不可使用「於是」（如不可說「天很黑，於是下雨了」）。
grammarPages.pattern: Preceding Situation + 於是 + Action Taken

text.traditional: 這點使得他睡不好，於是他放了一台愛心冰箱。
text.simplified: 这点使得他睡不好，于是他放了一台爱心冰箱。
text.pinyin: Zhè diǎn shǐde tā shuì bù hǎo, yúshì tā fàng le yì tái àixīn bīngxiāng.
text.english: This troubled his sleep; thereupon he placed a community fridge outside.

words.pinyin: zhè diǎn shǐ tā shuì bù hǎo
yúshì tā fàng le yì tái

text.traditional: 為了擁有舒適的生活，於是發明了許多實用商品。
text.simplified: 为了拥有舒适的生活，于是发明了许多实用商品。
text.pinyin: Wèile yǒngyǒu shūshì de shēnghuó, yúshì fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng shāngpǐn.
text.english: To have comfortable lives, people thereupon invented many useful goods.

text.traditional: 戴先生沒得到相對肯定，於是決定換新工作。
text.simplified: 戴先生没得到相对肯定，于是决定换新工作。
text.pinyin: Dài xiānsheng méi dédào xiāngduì kěndìng, yúshì juédìng huàn xīn gōngzuò.
text.english: Mr. Dai received no fair recognition, thereupon resolving to switch jobs.

items.question: Can 於是 be used for involuntary natural weather phenomena?
items.answer: No, 於是 cannot describe natural occurrences like rainfall; use 所以 instead.
items.wrongTraditional: 天空突然變得很黑，於開始下大雨了。
items.wrongSimplified: 天空突然变得很黑，于开始下大雨了。

right.traditional: 天空突然變得很黑，所以開始下大雨了。
right.simplified: 天空突然变得很黑，所以开始下大雨了。
right.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán biàn de hěn hēi, suǒyǐ kāishǐ xià dàyǔ le.
right.english: The sky suddenly turned very dark, so it started raining heavily.

items.question: How do you show a purposeful decision made in response to an unfair situation?
items.answer: Use 於是 to introduce the responsive action: 沒得到肯定，於是決定換工作.
items.wrongTraditional: 他沒得到肯定，況且決定換工作。
items.wrongSimplified: 他没得到肯定，况且决定换工作。

right.traditional: 他沒得到合理肯定，於是決定換工作。
right.simplified: 他没得到合理肯定，于是决定换工作。
right.pinyin: Tā méi dédào hélǐ kěndìng, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
right.english: He didn't receive fair recognition, whereupon he decided to change jobs.

questions.prompt: 選出表示緊接前文情況採取相應行動的連詞：

segments.text: 最初大家的反應冷淡，
他開始向客人說明愛心冰箱的理念。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「於是」連接前後情境，引出因應前句情況所採取的具體行動。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意接續行動：描述因前句狀況而採取的下一步作為，應使用「於是」。

items.prompt: Sleepless over food waste, he thereupon set up a donation fridge outside:

segments.traditional: 這點使得他夜裡睡不好。

result.traditional: 這點使得他夜裡睡不好。於是，他在門外放了一台冰箱。
result.simplified: 这点使得他夜里睡不好。于是，他在门外放了一台冰箱。
result.pinyin: Zhè diǎn shǐde tā yèlǐ shuì bù hǎo. Yúshì, tā zài ménwài fàng le yì tái bīngxiāng.
result.english: This troubled his sleep at night. Thereupon, he placed a fridge outside.

repairs.note: Use 於是 to introduce an action taken in response to a situation.
於是 describes taking prompt responsive action.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 於是.

items.prompt: People wanted more comfortable living, and thereupon invented practical home devices:

result.traditional: 為了擁有舒適的生活，於是發明了許多實用商品。
result.simplified: 为了拥有舒适的生活，于是发明了许多实用商品。
result.pinyin: Wèile yǒngyǒu shūshì de shēnghuó, yúshì fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng shāngpǐn.
result.english: To have comfortable lives, people thereupon invented many practical commodities.

repairs.note: Use 於是 to connect motivation with responsive innovation.
於是 indicates the purposeful invention.

items.prompt: He did not receive fair recognition, thereupon resolving to switch jobs:

result.traditional: 沒得到相對的肯定，於是他決定換一份新工作。
result.simplified: 没得到相对的肯定，于是他决定换一份新工作。
result.pinyin: Méi dédào xiāngduì de kěndìng, yúshì tā juédìng huàn yí fèn xīn gōngzuò.
result.english: Receiving no proportionate recognition, he thereupon decided to switch jobs.

items.prompt: Upon hearing that his child was sick, he rushed home immediately:

result.traditional: 家人告訴他孩子病了，於是他急忙搭車趕回家去。
result.simplified: 家人告诉他孩子病了，于是他急忙搭车赶回家去。
result.pinyin: Jiārén gàosù tā háizi bìng le, yúshì tā jímáng dāchē gǎn huíjiā qù.
result.english: His family informed him the child was sick, whereupon he rushed home by car.
